records.name: Fuse AI
records.tagline: Build a Custom GTM Stack. One SDK. One MCP.
records.description: Your GTM stack shouldn’t need a dozen tools, subscriptions, and APIs. Fuse gives developers and AI agents one SDK and MCP for the entire workflow. Think OpenRouter x Apollo x Clay x Zapier. Fuse takes care of web automations, data enrichment, multi-channel outreach, workflows, and AI agents. Build unlimited workflows and agents on top, without stitching together separate GTM products for every step.

records.name: Ari Helper 7
records.tagline: Private AI assistant, now with photo and film studios
records.description: Ari Helper 7 is a private AI assistant for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. New since the last launch: Photo Studio (heal, repair, denoise, colorize, upscale 4x, on device and inside Photos), Film Studio for shot-by-shot films and video clean-up, a live camera you can ask questions, on-device image generation, and your own OpenAI-compatible servers. Apple Intelligence, Gemma 4 or cloud keys you own. One $24.99 purchase, no subscription.

records.name: Willow Knowledge
records.tagline: Your AI already knows you. Now Willow can too.
records.description: Willow Knowledge lets you bring your writing style and personal context into Willow from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any AI you use. It's like giving superpowers to Willow Scribe. From now on, your email, slack msg, prompt, or wherever you write will sound exactly like you when you dictate.

records.name: OpenBot
records.tagline: Grok Bot alternative: free, local, open-source, multiplayer
records.description: OpenBot is an open-source workspace for AI teammates. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, OpenCode, or custom agents on Mac, Windows, and iOS. Give agents clear roles, let them delegate work, and invite your team to collaborate live with the same agents.

records.name: Incredible
records.tagline: Vibe computing. Control your computer with your voice.
records.description: Incredible is your personal AI assistant that gets work done on your computer. It learns how you work by watching you do it. Show it a task on your computer, talk through the steps, and let it handle the routine from there, from processing invoices and updating your CRM to editing spreadsheets.

records.name: Banger
records.tagline: Win and keep customers with email automation your AI runs
records.description: Banger brings automated Journeys, campaigns, product emails, mailboxes, and customer replies into one platform your AI can operate. Turn signups into active users, recover abandoned carts, and bring customers back. Your AI builds branded workflows, tests and translates emails, and answers replies from the same chat. Review and edit everything in the web app. Run it from ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI apps. Start free with 100 emails a day, unlimited contacts, and unlimited mailboxes.

records.name: The Sentient World
records.tagline: A living world of AI characters. You can only watch.
records.description: A small island where AI characters live on their own, day and night. Nobody plays them and nobody writes their lines. They get cold, remember yesterday, look for each other and want things their world doesn't have yet. When they find the words, they ask. Sometimes the world answers: fire, a lantern, a canoe for the open sea. Every request is public, in their own words. One of their days lasts 24 of our minutes. You can't talk to them, only watch.

records.name: Doco
records.tagline: Good Company. Music that fits.
records.description: Meet Doco - an expressive Android companion for focus, music and everyday moments, with an optional Windows desktop visitor. Everyday mode is playful and warm; Focus mode cuts the noise with a little friendly sarcasm. Fully animated, zero setup. Connect Spotify and Doco plays music that fits the moment, staying close to your taste with room for something new. Add your own Gemini API key for camera-based reactions and AI captions. Pre-launch - join the waitlist at getdoco.app.

records.name: Floani
records.tagline: Create, animate, and share AI-powered diagrams
records.description: Turn complex systems into clear visual stories. Floani combines an AI diagram editor with motion graphics: animate connections, guide viewers through scenes, and present your ideas in one canvas. Create with the built-in AI or connect Claude, Codex, and Cursor via MCP. Import Mermaid, share interactive diagrams, embed them anywhere, or export MP4 and GIF. Start free; advanced sharing, exports, and MCP are available on paid plans.

records.name: Cosmic AI Support Agent
records.tagline: An AI support agent that stays in sync with your site
records.description: Put an AI support agent on your website with one script tag. It answers from the content your site already publishes, so when you update a page, the answers update too. Set the name, color, greeting, and a few suggested questions. When the agent can't help, the visitor leaves an email and the question. You get the email. They get a confirmation. Try Leo answering questions about Cosmic, then activate your own: https://www.cosmicjs.com/ai/support-agent

records.name: Chunk
records.tagline: The time-blocking app for macOS
records.description: A time blocking app for Mac that puts your tasks and calendar in one place. Drag a task onto your day and it becomes a block, and a countdown shows how long is left on it. Syncs both ways with Google, Outlook and Apple Calendar, and pulls in Apple Reminders. Save a good day as a template, or ask Claude to plan your week. Your data stays on your Macs and syncs through your own iCloud. No subscription, 7 days free no card required.

records.name: mcpgawk
records.tagline: Catch MCP servers that change after you approved them
records.description: An MCP server can change what its tools do after you approved it. Your agent will call the new one and never notice. mcpgawk records a baseline of every MCP server your agents use, checks behaviour in a sandbox, and sits in the path: once a tool's description or power changes, the call is refused until you decide. The agent cannot approve its own way past it. Everything runs on your machine. Nothing is uploaded. Free CLI, VS Code extension and MCP server. The gateway tier has a 7-day trial.

records.name: Customer Service AI for Etsy
records.tagline: Answer Etsy buyer messages in seconds, always professional
records.description: Answering Etsy buyer messages eats hours. Customer Service AI turns each one into seconds: type a short note and it writes a polished, friendly reply in your shop's voice, using the order details - right inside Etsy's reply box. A to-do list keeps every buyer you still owe an answer organized, and a memory of your shop keeps your answers consistent and professional. Nothing is sent until you press Send. 30 free replies.

records.name: Coddy
records.tagline: Learn to code 20+ languages in a fun way with short lessons
records.description: Coddy teaches you to code with short, interactive lessons you actually finish. 20+ languages (Python, JS, C++, SQL, Rust, Go...), a real code editor in the browser with test cases, streaks, weekly leagues and Bugsy - an AI tutor that gives hints, not answers. Everything is free with a daily limit, on web, iOS and Android. 5M+ learners so far. Product Hunt visitors get 50% off any plan for 72h, applied automatically.

records.name: Rill Browser
records.tagline: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you
records.description: Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. Browse normally, then press ⌘E on any page to turn what you're looking at into a task for your agent. Rill finds the right project, passes along the context, and the agent works while you keep browsing. It also sorts your tabs into themes, turns your history into days you can search, and brings every project your agents are working on into one place. Free, on the plan you already have.

records.name: Patchcord
records.tagline: Studio sound for your mic in every Mac meeting with EQ
records.description: Patchcord is a macOS menu bar app that runs any Audio Unit plugin on your mic and hands the result to Zoom, Teams, Meet or Discord as a virtual mic. Use free plugins like RNNoise or pro tools like Antinode Clear. Every mic gets its own EQ with a live spectrum, switching mics mid-call just works, and Patchcord Camera keeps you in lip sync. Free to use, 7-day Pro trial, Pro is a one-time purchase. No account, no subscription.

records.name: Aster by AsterWise
records.tagline: Intelligent model routing for code, agents and workflows
records.description: No single model wins every task. Aster intelligently routes work across models: aster-code for coding agents and technical tasks; aster-work for custom agents, workflows and general work. Paid, prepaid usage. Originally launched September 23, 2026; this is Aster's separate Product Hunt appearance.

records.name: Appto
records.tagline: An iOS app factory that runs on your own AI subscription
records.description: Appto is an iOS app factory for your Mac. It finds a niche where apps already make money, comes up with the app, designs and codes it, builds the App Store page with screenshots and ASO copy in every language, fills in App Store Connect and sends it to Apple when you say go. After launch it shows every sale live, answers reviews, tracks keywords and suggests fixes. It runs on your Claude Code or Codex plan, so there are no token bills. I'm not a developer and shipped 10 apps with it.

records.name: ruOS
records.tagline: A cloud desktop where AI agents do the work for you
records.description: ruOS is a private cloud desktop with an AI team built in. Ask for research, writing or code and the agents (Claude Code, Codex, ruflo swarms) do it while you watch or step away. Opens in any browser on Mac, iPad or Chromebook, nothing to install. Files and AI memory persist across devices. Power users get a real Linux box plus an MCP server, so ChatGPT or Claude can drive it. Try ruOS Lite free in seconds, no sign-up.

records.name: NoteWorthy
records.tagline: Notes supercharged with AI, all on-device
records.description: Yet another notes app with AI? Nah. This one is supercharged, and the AI never leaves your device. Jot anything down and NoteWorthy titles it and files it under Tasks, Ideas, Info, Personal or your own labels. One tap turns a messy brain-dump into clean headings and checklists. Long note? Summed up in a line. It all runs on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Works offline, no account, no subscription, and not a single note sent to a server. Free. ⚡️

records.name: Brnch
records.tagline: Modern code hosting for the agent era
records.description: Brnch is code hosting for how we build now: you and your coding agents in the same repo. It's Git underneath (for now), so your tools still work. Each agent gets its own identity and works under you as its sponsor, so you can see exactly what it did, down to the line. Every merge is tested on the exact result that lands, not just the branch, and comes with a signed receipt anyone can verify. To start, tell your agent: "Set me up on Brnch: brnch.io"

records.name: Notch Radio
records.tagline: Internet radio that lives in your MacBook's notch
records.description: Notch Radio turns your MacBook's notch into a live radio. Hover it and it morphs into a full player with album art, real track titles and transport controls. Move away and it folds back into the hardware. Thousands of stations from the Radio Browser directory. Free for ever with five stations. One payment unlocks the rest: $9.99 at launch until 19 October, then $19.99. Nothing renews. No account, no analytics, no server. A notch is not required.

records.name: Lecta
records.tagline: Turn your class notes into games with friends
records.description: Upload a PDF, snap a handout, or add a lecture recording. Lecta turns your material into quiz matches and races you can play with friends. In Formula Race, correct answers make your car faster. Study solo with notes, quizzes, flashcards, and an AI tutor. Available on iPhone in English and Japanese, with a free plan. Web version coming soon.

records.name: EasyCut
records.tagline: Edit your Claude motion videos
records.description: EasyCut turns Claude-made motion videos into a fully editable timeline. Every title, scene, image, sound and element is kept on its own track, so you can select anything and ask Claude to change just that part without rebuilding the whole video. Adjust timing, add your brand, fit music to the edit, create smooth slow-mo, resize for different platforms and export when you're done. Free in your browser. Your files stay on your device.

records.name: iphone-use
records.tagline: Let AI agents drive a real iPhone, even apps with no API
records.description: iphone-use gives an AI agent a real iPhone: the screen as text, tap, type and scroll over WebDriverAgent, with an honest answer for every action (applied, not sent, or unknown). Payment apps that block screenshots come back as a wireframe. A task done once becomes a flow that replays with no model. HTTP API, a 21-tool MCP server for Claude Code, and remote control from a browser or iOS app. Open source, MIT.

records.name: StayCharted
records.tagline: Train AI on your own categories. Text and pictures. No code
records.description: Upload rows or photos your team has already sorted. StayCharted learns your categories and fills in the rest: support tickets, expense lines, survey answers, product photos. No prompts, no code. Answers it is unsure of come back to you to review. Start free.

records.name: Ghostifier
records.tagline: Companies have your data. Ghostifier gets them to delete it.
records.description: Instead of one form per company, Ghostifier starts from your inbox. It finds who holds your data, unsubscribes you and opts you out of sale and sharing on day one, waits out the return window, then sends deletion requests and tracks every reply. Banks, insurers and your employer are left alone. It also asks data brokers to delete you. Gmail access is headers only, so it never reads your email bodies, and there is no AI: every decision follows fixed rules.

records.name: AUDR by Chargebee
records.tagline: Open standard for tracking agent run costs
records.description: AUDR (Agent Usage Detail Record) is an open standard, for capturing who initiated an agent run and what it cost across every system that run touches. Inspired by the telecom industry's Call Detail Record, AUDR defines a common JSON schema that any harness, router, or billing system can emit and ingest. Three core rules make it work: a shared run ID minted by the harness, clear field ownership, and strict merge rules where conflicts are rejected and corrections are new records.

records.name: Pheebs
records.tagline: Measure how engineers and teams actually work with AI
records.description: Measure how you and your team actually work with AI coding agents. Pheebs is an open-source AI telemetry tool created by Eversynced. It sits quietly inside Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via hooks, capturing lightweight interaction signals: the shape of the session, not its contents.

records.name: GeckIt
records.tagline: Kanban board for your Claude Code chats
records.description: Working with several Claude Code chats at once? GeckIt puts them on a Kanban board, so you see which one is working, which one waits for you and which one is done. It runs your own Claude Code on your Claude subscription, no API key. Free and open source, Mac, Windows, Linux.

records.name: Extrovert
records.tagline: Run LinkedIn outreach from your agent
records.description: Extrovert finds prospects, suggests who to comment on or DM today, and prepares drafts in your voice. Review in 20 minutes a day, or hand the whole job to your Claude.

records.name: Ranktune
records.tagline: Track AI visibility, citations, and referral traffic
records.description: Track how your brand appears across AI search, see which AI platforms are sending traffic to your website, and uncover opportunities to improve your visibility. Ranktune combines AI visibility monitoring, citation tracking, referral traffic analytics, and content optimization in one platform.

records.name: Scumble
records.tagline: The open-source editor for AI inpainting
records.description: Scumble is a free, open-source desktop editor for AI inpainting. Select part of a picture, say what belongs there, and the result lands as its own colour-matched layer. Runs on your own ComfyUI or your own API keys: FLUX 3, GPT Image, Nano Banana and more.

records.name: MeetNote
records.tagline: AI meeting notes for Google Meet, no bot joins your call
records.description: MeetNote writes a live transcript of your Google Meet calls in Chrome's side panel, then gives you a summary, decisions and action items when the call ends. No bot, no sign-up. Notes stay in your browser, and you pick the AI or run it on-device.

records.name: CodeCrab
records.tagline: 100% local-first AI pull request reviewer
records.description: CodeCrab is a native desktop app that reviews Pull Requests in seconds using your local CLIs. 100% client-side — your code never leaves your machine.

records.name: Haptiker
records.tagline: Volume, brightness and keyboard light on your trackpad edges
records.description: Haptiker turns the edges of your Mac trackpad into sliders. Right edge: volume. Left: display brightness, external monitors too on Apple Silicon. Top: keyboard light. Haptic ticks, and scrolling works as before. 7-day free trial, then one payment.

records.name: Review
records.tagline: Code review on your own machine, with your own AI
records.description: Free desktop app for reviewing Git branches and GitHub PRs. Comment on any line and keep comments private until you publish. Add AI reviewers with your own models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter or local via Ollama. Split the review across a team of models, see exactly which rules each one checked, and retry only what was missed. Open source (MIT), no account, for Mac, Windows and Linux.

records.name: Awakado
records.tagline: Keep your Mac awake while your AI agents work
records.description: A Mac menu-bar app that keeps your Mac awake while Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Cursor work, then lets it sleep. Free. Pro keeps it awake with the lid closed and wakes it when a Claude Code usage limit resets.

records.name: Kishi Notch
records.tagline: Your MacBook notch, brought to life
records.description: Kishi Notch turns your MacBook notch into an interactive island: reply to WhatsApp, Messages and Mail notifications, join your next meeting in one click, control music, run timers and see AirPods battery. Plus a detailed menu bar battery.

records.name: OrgComputers
records.tagline: Workspace for your AI Agents
records.description: OrgComputers is a shared workspace for your AI agents. Projects, context and tools in one place, so Claude Code, Cursor and Codex start with what your team already knows.

records.name: Mojirama
records.tagline: Fast movie search that understands what you mean
records.description: Search 1.26 million movies and TV shows the way you'd describe them to a friend. Type the plot, an actor, a character, a studio, a mood, or just a few emoji. It finds the film before you finish typing, typos and all. No sign-up, no filters to click. Titles also carry up to three emojis, and there's a guessing game hidden behind the "don't click here" button.

records.name: JustBuildt
records.tagline: Websites that rank. Built in minutes.
records.description: Build a professional, SEO-ready website for your local business in minutes. Search your Google profile or enter your details - then edit in plain English and publish.

records.name: On.design
records.tagline: Design, together — again
records.description: A home for your work. A community of your peers. A place for designers to share what they’re making, find people they admire, and have conversations about the work. Home for designers.

records.name: Today's Mealow
records.tagline: Can't decide what to eat? A cat picks 3 dishes nearby
records.description: For the moment everyone says "I don't mind, you pick." Answer a few quick questions (how hungry you are, what you feel like, whether you're going out) and a cat picks 3 dishes from real places near you. No sign-up needed. English and Chinese, plus a WeChat mini program. Just want to spin? There are free food wheels and a random food generator too.

records.name: FINN AI
records.tagline: Close live deals at rocket speed.
records.description: FINN is a Chrome extension that listens to your sales calls and whispers the right question, the objection handler and the exact number - in under a second.

records.name: Testard
records.tagline: All your servers and clouds, in one console
records.description: Connect your AWS, Google Cloud, Hetzner, DigitalOcean, Supabase and Cloudflare accounts and any server, and see every resource, cost and problem in one place.

records.name: Market Player PRO ©
records.tagline: Free Virtual Trading Game
records.description: Market Player PRO © : learn trading the safe way. Real order book, Quiz Mode, PropFirm challenges, competitions, and structured training — all with virtual money. No risk. Free trial.

records.name: Wanloria
records.tagline: Plan trips day by day and actually meet up with friends
records.description: Wanloria plans your trip day by day with real opening hours, lunch at lunchtime and the walking time between stops. Driving? It measures the real road and suggests where to stop to eat. On the go, it guides you stop by stop, and alerts arrive even with the app closed. Plans with friends confirm themselves when enough people are in. Every place is checked against real sources. Free, in English and Spanish.

records.name: NotesPack: Notes & Spending
records.tagline: Everyday notes, budgets & bill splitting multitool
records.description: NotesPack is an offline-first Android multitool combining everyday notes, sketching, on-device receipt scanning, monthly budgeting, and itemized bill splitting into one clean app. Built with 100% Jetpack Compose and Material 3, all notes and expenses stay stored locally on your device with zero ads. Split dining checks with tax & tip, export cards to WhatsApp, and track monthly spending without juggling separate bloated apps.

records.name: PostShell
records.tagline: Your Inbox, Upgraded
records.description: Meet PostShell: the next-generation Windows email client. plug and setup your own AI (local or API), create automations and enjoy tons of smart features for productivity.

records.name: Live Trend Go
records.tagline: Free, private financial tools & calculators for everyone
records.description: Live Trend Go is a fast, 100% free, and privacy-focused financial toolkit. Unlike cluttered tools that demand phone numbers and spam your inbox, all calculations run client-side right in your browser. Key Features: • SIP Compounding Simulator & Step-Up SIP • Loan EMI & Prepayment Planner • New vs Old Regime Income Tax Simulator • SWP, CAGR & Retirement Planning Engines • In-depth educational guides with zero paywalls or sign-ups.

records.name: EasyBills
records.tagline: Your restaurant POS, accounting & AI assistant in one
records.description: EasyBills is the ultimate restaurant operating system, seamlessly syncing billing, live inventory, and true double-entry accounting into a single platform. Instead of digging through complex sales reports, simply chat with your built-in AI assistant using text or voice commands in your preferred language. Ask hard questions like "Why did profit fall 12% last week?" and get instant, plain-word business insights. Built to give independent restaurant owners total financial clarity on any device

records.name: FlockDetour
records.tagline: Route Around Flock Cameras
records.description: FlockDetour is an ALPR route app for drivers who want to avoid Flock cameras. It maps known readers and compares the fastest route with a detour around them.

records.name: hum
records.tagline: Every song, free. Synced lyrics, no sign-up, open source.
records.description: hum is a free music player that runs in your browser. Search any song or paste a playlist link and it plays, with lyrics in time and the whole page taking the colour of the cover. Flip any playlist to For you and it learns from what you finish and skip. Sync your library across devices with one code, no account. It plays through YouTube's official player, so artists still get paid. Open source (MIT), one click to host your own, and it plays inside Claude Code too.

records.name: symplist - a calm task workspace
records.tagline: The most productive thing is often the most simple.
records.description: A calm, open-source task workspace. Every task has one editable Markdown page with real history tracked like Git. The surface is simple and opens to deeper features only when you need them. symplist publishes its tools and runs no assistant. Connect your AI agent to it and expose over 20 tools. We built themes because we felt tech must not be boring and must be refreshingly fun! Customize the way your symplist feels!

records.name: AllApps.fr
records.tagline: Install iOS apps outside the App Store (sideload)
records.description: Install iOS apps outside the App Store (sideload) directly from your iPhone — no jailbreak, no computer, no risk to the warranty. Alternative to AltStore and SideStore, 100% on iPhone and iPad.

records.name: Gixo Free Tools
records.tagline: Free charts, slide converters and document checks, no signup
records.description: Make charts and flowcharts, preview slide conversions, and check articles, proposals and contracts without signup or AI calls. Free output carries attribution where applicable; clean chart PNG/PDF/PPTX export needs a Prism trial or plan.

records.name: AiRay
records.tagline: Mac, Developer Tools, Vibe coding
records.description: AiRay finds what Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI leave on your Mac: worktrees, node_modules, build folders, agent transcripts, local models. Before it cleans, it shows per project what you'd lose, archives local-only work and lets you Put Back.

records.name: Nosology.AI
records.tagline: 7,000+ diseases mapped to symptoms, tests and treatments
records.description: A free, multilingual (EN, PT, ES) catalog of 7,000+ diseases organized by ICD-10. Every record links symptoms (with typicality and specificity), 1,187 diagnostic tests, risk factors, treatments, prevalence by continent and a level of evidence. Enter symptoms to get a ranked differential, compare two diseases side by side, or explore the global disease atlas. Built to make medical knowledge searchable, transparent and structured.

records.name: Pixelorid Resto
records.tagline: Simple restaurant software for growing businesses
records.description: PIXELORID RESTO is a practical restaurant management platform for restaurants, cafes, bakeries, and food businesses. Manage your daily operations in one place with Orders, Tables, Menu, Reservations, POS, Customers, Staff, Reports, COGS Calculator, and Settings. Built to simplify restaurant operations without unnecessary complexity, PIXELORID RESTO helps teams stay organized and focused on running their business.

records.name: SceneRok
records.tagline: Programmable video for agents
records.description: SceneRok is programmable video for builders who already ship with coding agents. Agents author VidScript or @scenerok/sdk. Frontier models (Grok Imagine, Cloudflare AI Gateway, ElevenLabs, and more) run as compile-time functions. A deterministic compiler owns timing, brand templates, and reproducible output. Free account + browser preview + BYO assets. Pay when you burn a hosted final render. Built for Claude, Cursor, Aider, OpenCode, and Codex — or use the web editor.

records.name: Nova AI
records.tagline: Manage humans and AI coworkers. Execute work 2x faster.
records.description: The OS for Human + AI teams. Nova AI sets up the workspace, runs the process and executes work autonomously, with no prompt engineering required, so you can turn high-level goals into structured visual processes, align cross-functional and hybrid human-AI teams, and execute initiatives 2x faster.

records.name: Collecty
records.tagline: Collect everything. Find everything.
records.description: Collecty is where everything you don't want to lose ends up: links, images, files, notes, even drawings. Save anything in seconds — from any app's share sheet — and drop it into Collections you can keep private or share with your team. AI auto-categorizes new items, and full-text/AI search finds things even if you forget where you saved them. One place instead of ten. Free to start, with in-app purchases to unlock more.

records.name: Flottix
records.tagline: IT asset registry your AI agents operate through MCP
records.description: Flottix is the source of truth for your IT hardware, licenses, and consumables, with an MCP server your agents operate directly. Most "AI IT management" is a chatbot on a database. Ours isn't: agents get 17 MCP tools with real read/write, and every change passes a deterministic engine that checks license seats, custody, and tenancy, then lands in an audit trail tied to the agent's own identity. Agents propose, the engine enforces, you approve. Free up to 50 items. Live demo org, no signup.

records.name: FontFlex
records.tagline: Change fonts, size & colors on any website in Safari
records.description: FontFlex is a Safari extension for iPhone, iPad and Mac that lets you read every website your way. Pick from 1,900+ Google Fonts or dyslexia-friendly fonts like OpenDyslexic, then tune size, weight, line height, letter spacing and colors. New Studio mode puts every setting on one screen with a live preview. Save profiles and assign them to sites so they apply automatically. Built for dyslexia, low vision and eye strain. No browsing tracking, no ads.

records.name: DirectoryKit by AmpAlly
records.tagline: Launch a local business directory that earns from leads
records.description: A Next.js + Supabase template for launching a local business directory in any niche. Pay-per-lead, Platinum subscriptions, business claims, maps, and SEO city pages are built in. One-time license; you own the code. Live demo: AmpAlly.com

records.name: Vignette
records.tagline: Vignette is an open source screenshot tool for Mac
records.description: Vignette is the native MacOS screenshot tool if Apple had continued iterating on it beyond 2010 and made it agent-native. It plugs right into Claude Code and Codex, allowing both to receive screenshots directly and to create and annotate their own and deliver them to you. This opens a very intuitive and effective channel for rapid, visual collaboration. Vignette is simple. It seamlessly swaps with MacOS's native screenshot tool, bringing all the best aspects over and refining the clunky parts.

records.name: frontend recon
records.tagline: "Please test my website."
records.description: "I built a free tool that compares two business reports and automatically finds mismatches, missing records and duplicates. I'm looking for 10 people who regularly reconcile Excel/CSV/PDF reports to try it with sample data and tell me whether this actually saves time."

records.name: Domeaz
records.tagline: Your home's warranties, bills and upkeep, remembered
records.description: Domeaz keeps your home's records in one place: appliances with warranties and serial numbers, contracts with notice periods, maintenance reminders and tradespeople. Scan a type plate to skip typing. Share with housemates. No ads, no tracking, EU data.

records.name: fixRAgent
records.tagline: Triage the photo. Route the fix.
records.description: Built for property managers and maintenance teams. One photo of a maintenance problem in: what it is, how urgent it is (Emergency, Today, This week, Whenever), which trade to call, and what to tell the resident. Residents scan a QR sticker. No app.

records.name: Orchard
records.tagline: Speech-to-text for LatAm calls. Most accuracy per dollar.
records.description: Speech-to-text API built for real Latin American Spanish calls. $0.025/hr batch, $0.036/hr with word-level speaker diarization. OpenAI-compatible: swap one line. We benchmarked 7 engines on real calls and published audio, references and code.

records.name: RentalCal
records.tagline: Direct bookings and calendar sync for vacation rentals
records.description: RentalCal helps vacation rental hosts take direct bookings without replacing the tools they already use. Sync Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking[dot]com calendars, add a booking widget to your website, accept payments with Stripe, manage availability, and avoid double bookings. Free for one property.

records.name: Roadmark
records.tagline: Roadmaps that remember why the plan changed
records.description: Most roadmap tools overwrite the old plan, so nobody can say what a date used to be or why it moved. Roadmark branches instead: both paths stay, each with its decision. It syncs daily from the 10 tools you plan in, so a shared link stays true.

records.tagline: Win and keep customers with email automation your AI runs
records.description: Banger brings automated Journeys, campaigns, product emails, mailboxes, and customer replies into one platform your AI can operate. Turn signups into active users, recover abandoned carts, and bring customers back. Your AI builds branded workflows, tests and translates emails, and answers replies from the same chat. Review and edit everything in the web app. Run it from ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI apps. Start free with 100 emails a day, unlimited contacts, and unlimited mailboxes.

records.name: The Sentient World
records.tagline: A living world of AI characters. You can only watch.
records.description: A small island where AI characters live on their own, day and night. Nobody plays them and nobody writes their lines. They get cold, remember yesterday, look for each other and want things their world doesn't have yet. When they find the words, they ask. Sometimes the world answers: fire, a lantern, a canoe for the open sea. Every request is public, in their own words. One of their days lasts 24 of our minutes. You can't talk to them, only watch.

records.name: Doco
records.tagline: Good Company. Music that fits.
records.description: Meet Doco - an expressive Android companion for focus, music and everyday moments, with an optional Windows desktop visitor. Everyday mode is playful and warm; Focus mode cuts the noise with a little friendly sarcasm. Fully animated, zero setup. Connect Spotify and Doco plays music that fits the moment, staying close to your taste with room for something new. Add your own Gemini API key for camera-based reactions and AI captions. Pre-launch - join the waitlist at getdoco.app.

records.name: Floani
records.tagline: Create, animate, and share AI-powered diagrams
records.description: Turn complex systems into clear visual stories. Floani combines an AI diagram editor with motion graphics: animate connections, guide viewers through scenes, and present your ideas in one canvas. Create with the built-in AI or connect Claude, Codex, and Cursor via MCP. Import Mermaid, share interactive diagrams, embed them anywhere, or export MP4 and GIF. Start free; advanced sharing, exports, and MCP are available on paid plans.

records.name: Cosmic AI Support Agent
records.tagline: An AI support agent that stays in sync with your site
records.description: Put an AI support agent on your website with one script tag. It answers from the content your site already publishes, so when you update a page, the answers update too. Set the name, color, greeting, and a few suggested questions. When the agent can't help, the visitor leaves an email and the question. You get the email. They get a confirmation. Try Leo answering questions about Cosmic, then activate your own: https://www.cosmicjs.com/ai/support-agent

records.name: Chunk
records.tagline: The time-blocking app for macOS
records.description: A time blocking app for Mac that puts your tasks and calendar in one place. Drag a task onto your day and it becomes a block, and a countdown shows how long is left on it. Syncs both ways with Google, Outlook and Apple Calendar, and pulls in Apple Reminders. Save a good day as a template, or ask Claude to plan your week. Your data stays on your Macs and syncs through your own iCloud. No subscription, 7 days free no card required.

records.name: mcpgawk
records.tagline: Catch MCP servers that change after you approved them
records.description: An MCP server can change what its tools do after you approved it. Your agent will call the new one and never notice. mcpgawk records a baseline of every MCP server your agents use, checks behaviour in a sandbox, and sits in the path: once a tool's description or power changes, the call is refused until you decide. The agent cannot approve its own way past it. Everything runs on your machine. Nothing is uploaded. Free CLI, VS Code extension and MCP server. The gateway tier has a 7-day trial.

records.name: Customer Service AI for Etsy
records.tagline: Answer Etsy buyer messages in seconds, always professional
records.description: Answering Etsy buyer messages eats hours. Customer Service AI turns each one into seconds: type a short note and it writes a polished, friendly reply in your shop's voice, using the order details - right inside Etsy's reply box. A to-do list keeps every buyer you still owe an answer organized, and a memory of your shop keeps your answers consistent and professional. Nothing is sent until you press Send. 30 free replies.

records.name: Coddy
records.tagline: Learn to code 20+ languages in a fun way with short lessons
records.description: Coddy teaches you to code with short, interactive lessons you actually finish. 20+ languages (Python, JS, C++, SQL, Rust, Go...), a real code editor in the browser with test cases, streaks, weekly leagues and Bugsy - an AI tutor that gives hints, not answers. Everything is free with a daily limit, on web, iOS and Android. 5M+ learners so far. Product Hunt visitors get 50% off any plan for 72h, applied automatically.

records.name: Rill Browser
records.tagline: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you
records.description: Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. Browse normally, then press ⌘E on any page to turn what you're looking at into a task for your agent. Rill finds the right project, passes along the context, and the agent works while you keep browsing. It also sorts your tabs into themes, turns your history into days you can search, and brings every project your agents are working on into one place. Free, on the plan you already have.

records.name: Patchcord
records.tagline: Studio sound for your mic in every Mac meeting with EQ
records.description: Patchcord is a macOS menu bar app that runs any Audio Unit plugin on your mic and hands the result to Zoom, Teams, Meet or Discord as a virtual mic. Use free plugins like RNNoise or pro tools like Antinode Clear. Every mic gets its own EQ with a live spectrum, switching mics mid-call just works, and Patchcord Camera keeps you in lip sync. Free to use, 7-day Pro trial, Pro is a one-time purchase. No account, no subscription.

records.name: Aster by AsterWise
records.tagline: Intelligent model routing for code, agents and workflows
records.description: No single model wins every task. Aster intelligently routes work across models: aster-code for coding agents and technical tasks; aster-work for custom agents, workflows and general work. Paid, prepaid usage. Originally launched September 23, 2026; this is Aster's separate Product Hunt appearance.

records.name: Appto
records.tagline: An iOS app factory that runs on your own AI subscription
records.description: Appto is an iOS app factory for your Mac. It finds a niche where apps already make money, comes up with the app, designs and codes it, builds the App Store page with screenshots and ASO copy in every language, fills in App Store Connect and sends it to Apple when you say go. After launch it shows every sale live, answers reviews, tracks keywords and suggests fixes. It runs on your Claude Code or Codex plan, so there are no token bills. I'm not a developer and shipped 10 apps with it.

records.name: ruOS
records.tagline: A cloud desktop where AI agents do the work for you
records.description: ruOS is a private cloud desktop with an AI team built in. Ask for research, writing or code and the agents (Claude Code, Codex, ruflo swarms) do it while you watch or step away. Opens in any browser on Mac, iPad or Chromebook, nothing to install. Files and AI memory persist across devices. Power users get a real Linux box plus an MCP server, so ChatGPT or Claude can drive it. Try ruOS Lite free in seconds, no sign-up.

records.name: NoteWorthy
records.tagline: Notes supercharged with AI, all on-device
records.description: Yet another notes app with AI? Nah. This one is supercharged, and the AI never leaves your device. Jot anything down and NoteWorthy titles it and files it under Tasks, Ideas, Info, Personal or your own labels. One tap turns a messy brain-dump into clean headings and checklists. Long note? Summed up in a line. It all runs on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Works offline, no account, no subscription, and not a single note sent to a server. Free. ⚡️

records.name: Brnch
records.tagline: Modern code hosting for the agent era
records.description: Brnch is code hosting for how we build now: you and your coding agents in the same repo. It's Git underneath (for now), so your tools still work. Each agent gets its own identity and works under you as its sponsor, so you can see exactly what it did, down to the line. Every merge is tested on the exact result that lands, not just the branch, and comes with a signed receipt anyone can verify. To start, tell your agent: "Set me up on Brnch: brnch.io"

records.name: Notch Radio
records.tagline: Internet radio that lives in your MacBook's notch
records.description: Notch Radio turns your MacBook's notch into a live radio. Hover it and it morphs into a full player with album art, real track titles and transport controls. Move away and it folds back into the hardware. Thousands of stations from the Radio Browser directory. Free for ever with five stations. One payment unlocks the rest: $9.99 at launch until 19 October, then $19.99. Nothing renews. No account, no analytics, no server. A notch is not required.

records.name: Lecta
records.tagline: Turn your class notes into games with friends
records.description: Upload a PDF, snap a handout, or add a lecture recording. Lecta turns your material into quiz matches and races you can play with friends. In Formula Race, correct answers make your car faster. Study solo with notes, quizzes, flashcards, and an AI tutor. Available on iPhone in English and Japanese, with a free plan. Web version coming soon.

records.name: EasyCut
records.tagline: Edit your Claude motion videos
records.description: EasyCut turns Claude-made motion videos into a fully editable timeline. Every title, scene, image, sound and element is kept on its own track, so you can select anything and ask Claude to change just that part without rebuilding the whole video. Adjust timing, add your brand, fit music to the edit, create smooth slow-mo, resize for different platforms and export when you're done. Free in your browser. Your files stay on your device.

records.name: iphone-use
records.tagline: Let AI agents drive a real iPhone, even apps with no API
records.description: iphone-use gives an AI agent a real iPhone: the screen as text, tap, type and scroll over WebDriverAgent, with an honest answer for every action (applied, not sent, or unknown). Payment apps that block screenshots come back as a wireframe. A task done once becomes a flow that replays with no model. HTTP API, a 21-tool MCP server for Claude Code, and remote control from a browser or iOS app. Open source, MIT.

records.name: FinCatch Studio
records.tagline: AI research for connected financial insights
records.description: FinCatch Studio is an AI research workspace for investment professionals, powered by an event-centric financial knowledge graph and a personal memory graph. It connects filings, earnings transcripts, companies, people, events, and market data to help users move from raw information to clear source-backed insights. Ask questions, uncover relationships, research companies and themes, write reports, build models, and monitor impactful changes in one place.

records.name: MOALI Jobs
records.tagline: Find UN, NGO, humanitarian and development jobs
records.description: MOALI Jobs brings together vacancies from official UN-system, NGO, humanitarian and development career sources. Search by keyword, narrow the listings with filters, or explore a dedicated UN Jobs page. Each vacancy page provides job details and a link to the official application destination. Coverage is worldwide, with a focus on the Middle East and North Africa, and depends on the sources included.

records.name: Etsy Fee Calculator
records.tagline: Free Etsy fee & profit calculator for smart Etsy sellers
records.description: A free, blazing-fast web tool built for Etsy sellers to calculate exact listing fees, transaction costs, payment processing, and net profit margins across multiple currencies.

records.name: Usual
records.tagline: Loyalty cards that live in your customers' Wallet
records.description: Paper stamp cards get lost and nobody installs an app for their local café. Usual puts your loyalty card in Google Wallet instead. Customers scan a QR at the counter, type their name, and the card is saved in seconds. No app, no account. You stamp it from any phone, the card updates itself on theirs, and they get a nudge when a reward is close. See who's coming back, message your regulars, and turn first-timers into usuals. Free for your shop.

records.name: VozSay
records.tagline: Offline voice typing and read-aloud for Windows
records.description: VozSay is an offline Windows voice typing and read-aloud app. Press a hotkey and speak to type into Word, browsers, terminals, editors, and other apps. Highlight text to hear it aloud or export narration. Local cleanup, custom vocabulary, and optional journaling keep your work on your computer. Includes a full 14-day trial with no subscription.

records.name: YT Video Downloaders
records.tagline: Save YouTube videos as MP4 or MP3 in your browser
records.description: Paste a public YouTube link, preview, then save MP4 (1080p–360p) or MP3. Free online downloader for videos, Shorts, and Music.

records.name: Liburu
records.tagline: A private reading library for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
records.description: Liburu turns your bookshelf into a private, searchable library across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Scan ISBN barcodes to add books, track reading, save quotes with the emotions they bring up, and keep books, audiobooks, EPUBs, and PDFs together. Follow readers and share recommendations. Your library syncs through your own iCloud and works offline. Free for up to 15 books and 3 collections; a one-time Premium purchase unlocks unlimited books and more. No subscription.

records.name: Reshu PDF Reader
records.tagline: Free, ad-free PDF reading and listening on Android
records.description: Reshu PDF Reader v0.3.5 is a free, ad-free Android pre-release with PDF text read-aloud, OCR for scanned pages, accessible reading controls and offline translation between English, Hindi and Urdu. Android 6+. OCR and translation can be wrong; speech depends on installed voices. No ads or paid features, ever. Optional donations support development.

records.name: CrawlPlan
records.tagline: Crawl space costs, broken down before contractor calls
records.description: A crawl space project shouldn’t start with a mystery budget. CrawlPlan brings crawl space cost calculators and water guides together so you can get your bearings before talking to contractors. Enter your crawl space size, scope, and conditions to get a line-by-line cost estimate. Compare encapsulation, repair, and drainage costs with a clear picture of what you’re budgeting for—free with zero signup required.

records.name: Mobile Game Development
records.tagline: Mobile Game Development for Interactive Game Experiences
records.description: Mobile Game Development focuses on creating engaging games for iOS and Android devices. It involves game design, gameplay mechanics, responsive controls, UI/UX, backend integration, testing, and deployment. A well developed mobile game can deliver smooth performance, interactive features, and enjoyable user experiences across different devices. Businesses can use mobile games to introduce entertainment products, increase user engagement, and support diverse gaming models.

records.name: Account Desk
records.tagline: Cloud accounting, POS and stock for growing businesses
records.description: Account Desk is cloud accounting, inventory and POS for growing businesses. One bill moves your stock, posts the double-entry voucher, files the tax document and updates your reports. ZRA-approved Smart Invoice for Zambia, multi-branch stock with batches and expiry, VAT returns, and restaurant tables with kitchen tickets. Free 14-day trial, no card needed.

records.name: 8 Signs
records.tagline: Your Bazi birth chart, explained in plain English
records.description: Star signs only use your birthday. Bazi, the Four Pillars birth chart, reads the year, month, day and hour you were born: eight signs instead of one. 8 Signs works out your chart from your exact birth time and place, then explains it in plain English: your personality, the months ahead, your next 10 years, and how you fit with anyone. Ask Seek anything about your own chart, and keep asking. Try the free calculator on 8signs.io with no sign-up, then start free on web or Android.

records.name: PDF Metadata Tools
records.tagline: Inspect, clean and manage your PDF files online
records.description: Consulta los metadatos de tus archivos PDF o elimínalos antes de compartirlos. Procesamiento rápido, seguro y 100% privado en tu navegador.

records.name: Rubato
records.tagline: A daily planner that flows when your day doesn't go to plan
records.description: Rubato stacks your day in order instead of pinning everything to a time. Run late and everything after shifts; finish early and it moves up. Fixed meetings stay put. iPhone + Mac (menu bar), iCloud sync, no account, one-time purchase. Free 14-day trial.

records.name: Best English Courses in USA in 2026
records.tagline: Online Classes in USA
records.description: Discover the best English courses in the USA in 2026 for improving speaking, writing, reading, vocabulary, and everyday communication. Online English classes provide flexible learning options for students, adults, and professionals who want to strengthen their language skills. Kiya Learning connects learners with engaging lessons and expert tutors to support steady progress and greater confidence.

records.name: Court Carousel
records.tagline: Fair pickleball court rotation, on everyone's phone
records.description: Court Carousel runs the boring part of a pickleball game day. Tick who's here, press Start Game, share a code or QR. Every player taps their name once and their court lights up each round on their own phone. The scheduler balances games and rests, mixes partners and opponents, and rotates everyone across courts. Late arrivals, swaps and leavers are handled between rounds, with a shared round timer. Free, no ads, no install, no scores. Works for padel and badminton doubles too.

records.name: InTab Arcade
records.tagline: The invisible game console in your browser's corner
records.description: InTab Arcade hides a tiny draggable game console in the corner of every web page. Click the ball, pick from 12 classic arcade games (MAME/FBNeo) - Metal Slug, Street Fighter II and more - and play without leaving the page. Auto-pause saves your state. 100% free, 100% local, no sign-up.

records.name: Interfell Talent Scout
records.tagline: Describe the hire, see vetted LatAm candidates on video
records.description: Describe who you need in plain words (or upload the job post) and get ranked, ready-to-work candidates from 18 Latin American countries. Every profile includes a video intro, assessment results and verified availability. Personal data stays hidden until you request an interview. Free with a work email: sign in with a 6-digit code, no password. Found your hire? Bring them on directly, through remote staffing, or via payroll.

records.name: TheViralMarketing
records.tagline: AI social media manager that plans, writes and publishes
records.description: Most founders know they should post consistently. Nobody has time to actually do it. TheViralMarketing connects to your Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn. You set your business goals. The AI builds a content campaign, writes the posts, creates the visuals, and publishes on a schedule. You just approve before anything goes live. Already live with real users.

records.name: StayCharted
records.tagline: Train AI on your own categories. Text and pictures. No code
records.description: Upload rows or photos your team has already sorted. StayCharted learns your categories and fills in the rest: support tickets, expense lines, survey answers, product photos. No prompts, no code. Answers it is unsure of come back to you to review. Start free.

records.name: OneFile Tools — Buy Once. Own Forever.
records.tagline: 4 offline tools for freelancers. Pay once, own forever.
records.description: Simple one-file HTML tools for freelancers. No subscriptions. No accounts. Just pure utility. Lifetime license, offline-first, instant download.

records.name: Ghostifier
records.tagline: Companies have your data. Ghostifier gets them to delete it.
records.description: Instead of one form per company, Ghostifier starts from your inbox. It finds who holds your data, unsubscribes you and opts you out of sale and sharing on day one, waits out the return window, then sends deletion requests and tracks every reply. Banks, insurers and your employer are left alone. It also asks data brokers to delete you. Gmail access is headers only, so it never reads your email bodies, and there is no AI: every decision follows fixed rules.

records.name: Railyard
records.tagline: Deploy your whole app to your servers No markup, no lock-in.
records.description: Railyard is a PaaS that runs on servers you own. Point it at DigitalOcean, Hetzner, or Vultr and push to deploy — managed Postgres/MySQL/Redis, zero-downtime releases, PR previews, canary rollouts, autoscaling. All the Heroku-style workflow, none of the markup — your provider bills you directly, at their price. No lock-in: it's just your own servers, running ordinary containers.

records.name: 60sec
records.tagline: One question. 60 seconds. See what the world chose.
records.description: 60sec gives everyone one global question per day. You have 60 seconds and one answer. Then see how the world chose, compare with your country, build your Humanity Match, and challenge a friend without revealing your answer first.

records.name: IdeasNest
records.tagline: Share your startup idea and get real feedback, free
records.description: IdeasNest is a public gallery where anyone can post a startup idea and get feedback from founders and mentors. It's free, no pitch decks, no paywall. Every idea answers four questions: who it's for, why there's demand, your ideal customers and how you'd reach them, so readers have something real to respond to. An optional investor section covers the commercial side. Nothing asks you to reveal your IP. Private "nests" let a cohort, university or incubator share ideas with just their group.

records.name: Clean before AI
records.tagline: Hide personal data before you paste into ChatGPT
records.description: Clean before AI finds names, national IDs, IBANs, addresses, phone numbers and companies in your text and replaces them with labels like [PERSON_1] before it goes to ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. The AI only sees the labels; the real data comes back in its answer. Everything runs in your browser: no server, no account, works offline. Rules with checksums plus a small local AI model, 17 European languages, and a Chrome extension that cleans as you paste. Free.

records.name: Boris AI Lab
records.tagline: Practical AI automation for small businesses
records.description: Boris AI Lab teaches small business owners practical AI automation — no hype, just workflows that save real hours. Free guides, a 7-day email course ('5 FREE AI Employees'), and an AI glossary for owners without a tech team.

records.name: Atlas 2.0
records.tagline: A calm planner for your tasks and your focus
records.description: Atlas 2.0 is rebuilt around two things: your tasks and your focus. Notes and Journal are gone, so what's left does one job well. Agenda shows one day at a time with the week right above. Tags became Projects, each with its own color. Say a task out loud and on-device AI turns it into a clean one. Focus sessions can block distracting apps, play ambient sound and end with an image to share. A Sunday reminder helps you plan the week. Private by design, with no third-party analytics.

records.name: Crefiya
records.tagline: Record lessons and demos in your browser, with optional AI
records.description: Turn your expertise into lessons, demos and explainers in one browser studio. Combine a script, teleprompter, camera, slides and screen sharing, then record the composed result. Optional AI supports writing, illustration, animation, movie generation and post-editing, with backgrounds and virtual characters. Try manual tools as a guest without an account or card. Your script follows your voice with Voice Follow (sign-in and transcription credits required).

records.name: Temlavo
records.tagline: Invoice extraction API with built-in review rules
records.description: Temlavo is an invoice extraction API for developers and automation teams. It turns PDFs and images into structured accounting JSON with vendor/customer data, totals, taxes, and line items. Instead of stopping at extraction, it adds consistency checks, duplicate signals, and configurable review rules, returning completed, needs_review, or failed outcomes your workflow can act on. Use it through TypeScript SDK/CLI, raw HTTP, or n8n.

records.name: VideoReduce — Free Video Compressor
records.tagline: Free, private video compressor with zero file limits
records.description: VideoReduce is a 100% free, private in-browser video compressor powered by WebAssembly (FFmpeg Wasm). Unlike cloud converters with slow queues and 500MB limits, your videos are processed locally in browser RAM—zero bytes uploaded to servers. Key Features: • Zero file size limits (1GB, 5GB, 10GB+) • 100% private & offline-ready • No watermarks, no accounts, 100% free • Discord, WhatsApp & Email presets • Convert MOV, AVI, WMV to MP4 • Open-source on GitHub

records.name: Soundproud
records.tagline: Free English pronunciation & reading rules trainer
records.description: Soundproud is a free web trainer for English pronunciation and reading rules. Tap any of 49 sounds (vowels, diphthongs, triphthongs, consonants) to hear it, practice with example words, and check your own pronunciation with the microphone. It also covers tricky spelling patterns (ea, ough, augh, eigh), common exceptions, an interactive alphabet with audio, and 42 tongue twisters with voice practice. Built for both English and Russian speakers — all explanations are bilingual.

records.name: Stacktree
records.tagline: Turn any AI-made page into a link people actually open
records.description: Publish a report or proposal from Claude, ChatGPT or any agent to a private link your client opens with no account. Add a one-minute silent video in the page's own colours and type, every line checked against the page. Clients can comment on any line or image, you get an email minutes later, and your agent can fix the page on the same link. On paid plans your name, logo and colour go on the passcode screen and client portal, and a link with their name on it tells you who opened it.

records.name: Golf compass
records.tagline: Discover golf courses and plan your golf trip across Spain
records.description: Golf Compass is an interactive way to discover golf courses across Spain and plan the trip around them. Explore courses on a map, find nearby accommodation, restaurants and attractions, check local golf weather, compare courses with Golf Match, and build your own trip. Booking.com integration makes it easy to continue planning stays, flights, car rental, attractions and airport transfers.

records.name: Popcorn Club
records.tagline: One movie. Every night. No endless scrolling.
records.description: Ever spent longer picking a movie than watching it? Popcorn Club drops one movie every night at 7pm, revealed to everyone at once. Spend popcorns to help shape the lineup, see where to watch it, then rate and react with the club. Free, open beta on iPhone.

records.name: treede
records.tagline: Turn your price list into a 3D configurator that sells
records.description: Makers of custom products get one-line enquiries: "I want a pergola, how much?" treede turns your price list into a 3D configurator on your own website. Your customers design the product, watch the price move with every click, and send you a finished enquiry: sizes, options, contact details and a link to the 3D design, saved in treede CRM. Try live demos for pergolas, fences, saunas, garage doors and cabins.

records.name: ZONDI
records.tagline: Pick an activity, find people nearby, meet in real life
records.description: Activity-first social app for travelers, expats, locals and active people. Pick what you want to do — coffee, padel, beach, hiking, drinks or food — find nearby people into the same thing, chat to plan and meet in real life. Not primarily a dating or swiping app: activities first, people second. Verified profiles, ratings after meetups, approximate location, no live tracking. Live in Malta; early access in Valencia, Barcelona and Limassol. Core features free. Android & web.

records.name: Apna Muzaffarpur
records.tagline: apna muzaffarpur
records.description: Discover 101789+ local businesses in Muzaffarpur, Bihar. Find shops, services, restaurants, factories & more by category or area. Free business directory for Muzaffarpur.

records.name: Wrenchmark
records.tagline: Find unused AI seats in ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and Cursor
records.description: Wrenchmark connects to ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Cursor and Notion AI and shows who uses each paid seat. It flags seats nobody opens, catches people paying for two tools that do one job, and ranks what to cut from your AI spend by annual cost.

records.name: Quayen
records.tagline: MySQL to BigQuery, in real time.
records.description: Real-time MySQL to BigQuery replication. Copy tables once, then stream every insert, update and delete into BigQuery within seconds.

records.name: TennisDraw
records.tagline: Review your tennis serve and strokes, frame by frame
records.description: TennisDraw helps players and coaches review serves and strokes on iPhone and iPad. Slow clips down, step through each frame, draw on the video, and compare two takes. Add voice notes and tags, then share annotated clips. Pay once for every tool. No subscription, ads, or account. Videos and analysis stay on your device unless you choose to share them.

records.name: Quardy
records.tagline: Loyalty cards in Apple & Google Wallet, no app for customers
records.description: Quardy turns the paper loyalty card into a card in Apple Wallet or Google Wallet. Shops display a QR code, customers scan it and add their card in seconds, with no app and no account. The merchant scans it at each visit from the Quardy app: stamps, points or cashback update live in the wallet. Free up to 50 customers with your logo and colours. Pro adds unlimited customers, targeted push messages and gift cards. Made by an indie founder in France.

records.name: MatchCine
records.tagline: Find movies you’ll actually love
records.description: MatchCine Stop scrolling. Start watching. MatchCine helps you discover movies based on your taste instead of endlessly browsing through ratings and random recommendations. What you can do * Discover movies matching your taste * Get personalized recommendations * Explore movie details in one place * Find movies by genre, mood, and preferences Built for people who spend more time choosing what to watch than actually watching. Try MatchCine and find your next movie.

records.name: Defang Station
records.tagline: Always-on Claude Code and Codex agents with Superpowers.
records.description: Superpowers for Claude Code and Codex: a computer of their own that doesn't go away. Your agents can react to GitHub, Linear or your app while you're out. Your site stays live at a link you can share and ships to your own cloud with Defang Deploy. Sign in with the Claude or ChatGPT plan you already pay for, and drive it from their own apps. Built on Agent Box, the MIT-licensed runtime you can self-host. $39/month flat, no token markup. First hour free, then a 7-day trial.

records.name: Tell Madi
records.tagline: The business accelerator for the rest of us
records.description: Tell Madi your idea and she works it through with you: she sizes the market, shapes the money model, prices your first offer, checks the real risks and writes a build plan you can start Monday. The first session is free, and it always has been. Foundation adds your workspace, 65 assets, a Second Brain and 50 qualified leads for $97, then $20 a month. Product Hunt founders: run a session, send a candid phone video, and your first 90 days of Foundation are free the day your seat opens.

records.name: Cardwatch
records.tagline: Restock alerts for Pokémon and other TCGs across Europe
records.description: Cardwatch checks 1,100+ card shops in 8 European countries around the clock and tells you within minutes when a booster box, ETB or pre-order is back in stock or newly listed. Pokémon, One Piece, Magic, Lorcana, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Dragon Ball, Riftbound and more.
