records.description: Lucky Dose is a daily capsule for clean energy and focus — no sugar, no liquids, no jitters. It combines three forms of energy, including PurCaf caffeine from green coffee bean and TeaCrine for 6–8 hour energy, with Cognizin citicoline and Huperzine A for focus — all at labeled doses. No proprietary blends. Third-party lab tested. *These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.*

records.name: Launch AI Tools.io
records.tagline: Curated AI directory & 300+ manual submission service.
records.description: Launch AI Tools.io is a curated AI tools directory and manual launch distribution platform. Founders can list their AI tool for free or order done-for-you submissions across 100 to 300+ verified directories with live proof.

records.name: QuiC
records.tagline: Encrypted team chat, calls and meetings for work
records.description: One app for team chat, calls, meetings and AI. Messages and 1:1/group calls are end-to-end encrypted; admins control users, devices and the audit log. iPhone, Android, Mac, web. From ₹99 (~$3)/user/month, free 14-day trial, cancel anytime.

records.name: Codalio
records.tagline: Spec-first AI software factory: idea to tested code
records.description: Most AI builds break around feature four because nothing ever defined the product. Codalio starts there. Describe your idea in plain English and it writes a validated PRD and spec: user flows, data model, user stories and acceptance criteria. It then generates code against that spec, writes the tests from the same criteria, and traces every change back to a requirement before the merge. Codalio Cloud takes you 95–98% of the way to production grade. Start with a free PRD.

records.name: Vestiarium
records.tagline: AI stylist: colour analysis and outfits from your closet
records.description: Vestiarium is an AI personal stylist that works with the clothes you already own. Start with a free colour analysis from a selfie (no sign-up, photo not stored) to find your season out of 12. Then photograph your wardrobe and get complete outfits built from your own pieces, matched to your palette, the weather and the occasion. It also plans your week, packs for trips and shows what's missing, so you buy less and better. In English and Spanish.

records.name: Avarodh
records.tagline: Zero-Trust AI gateway with DSPy routing & semantic caching
records.description: Most engineering teams deploying LLMs to production face two major roadblocks: skyrocketing API bills from redundant queries, and security audits stalled by unmonitored payloads and prompt injections. Avarodh solves this by acting as a transparent, zero-trust reverse proxy between your application backend and external AI providers: 1) Drop-In Integration 2) DSPy-Powered Firewall 3) Tenant-Isolated Semantic Cache 4) Control Plane & Live Telemetry 5) Privacy-First Supports Cache-Control

records.name: Echo
records.tagline: An AI that sees, understands, and acts on your Mac.
records.description: Echo is a native macOS AI that sees what’s on your screen, understands what you mean, and helps you get things done. Ask questions, point at anything, move files, control apps, dictate, and automate tasks, all from a small orb that lives on the edge of your screen.

records.name: RDesk
records.tagline: Browser-based remote support with consent built in
records.description: RDesk lets IT help desks see and control a Windows PC or Android phone straight from the browser — nothing to install for the technician. The person at the computer always clicks Allow, file access is a separate Allow, and a visible banner shows who is connected with an End button. Unattended access is opt-in and password-protected. Multi-tenant team accounts, per-user agent books, session history and self-hosting.

records.name: PodPulse Digest
records.tagline: Focused podcast briefings for what matters to you
records.description: PodPulse Digest turns every podcast episode into an interactive experience. Get quick summaries when you’re short on time, dive into detailed summaries when you want more, and chat with an AI agent that can answer questions and explore the episode with you. Discover the key ideas, skip the fluff, and easily share summaries with anyone.

records.name: Effect 4.0
records.tagline: A rebuilt, dependency-free core for the Effect framework
records.description: Effect 4.0 is a rebuilt version of the Effect framework, built by the Effect team with a dependency-free core, a faster runtime, and smaller bundles. Previously separate packages now ship together as one ecosystem under a single version. Starting with this release, every major version gets long-term support lasting at least three years.

records.name: BudgetPixel Design Templates
records.tagline: Free Design Templates
records.description: Free, editable design templates: Instagram posts, flyers, invitations, YouTube thumbnails, slides, résumés and planners. Change the text and photos, or ask the AI designer.

records.name: Spend pace
records.tagline: Know how much you can SPEND after all expenses and savings.
records.description: Hi everyone! I built Spend Pace because most budgeting apps ask for too much: accounts, bank logins, and hours of setup. I wanted one simple answer: "How much can I actually spend this week?" How it works: 1. Enter your income 2. Add your bills, food, and savings 3. See exactly what's left to spend No signup, no bank connection, and your numbers stay on your phone. I'd love your feedback: what would make this more useful? Anything confusing or missing? Try it here: https://spendpaceapp.app

records.name: Busirank
records.tagline: Automate your Google Business Profile with AI.
records.description: AI-powered Google Business Profile management, automated review replies, post generation and scheduling, local SEO analytics, and multi-location automation.

records.name: TakeApp India
records.tagline: Billing and POS software for small businesses in India
records.description: TakeApp brings billing, Quick POS, inventory and customer records into one workspace on web and Android. Create itemised invoices, print or share PDFs, record sales, track supplier purchases and expenses, and share an online-store link. Explore a free demo; the website offers a 7-day trial for INR 1, followed by INR 99/month at checkout.

records.name: Anyeria
records.tagline: Safer random video chat with nudity blur and karma trust
records.description: Anyeria is an 18+ random video, audio and text chat that runs in your browser. Unlike older random-chat sites, safety is built in: nudity stays blurred until both people tap to show, a karma-based trust system and trusted badge filter out repeat offenders, and reports come with evidence. Match by interests, reconnect with past chats, join live voice rooms for football and cricket, and break the ice with mini-games. Free to chat. Optional filters from ₹29.

records.name: One Screen. All Markets.
records.tagline: The Fastest Way to Read the World’s Markets
records.description: Multi‑asset dashboard that gives you a clean, unified view of global markets - all on one screen. It streams live updates across indices, futures, crypto, FX, commodities, bond yields, volatility, and macro sentiment at a glance. You get: * Live prices for major global indices and regional market status * VIX, Fear & Greed, breadth, momentum, safe‑haven flows * AI Mood - update every hour * Top gainers & losers updated in real time * Macro calendar and much more * Completely free access

records.name: Sri Karya Sidhi Ganapathi
records.tagline: Book a Pujari, Poojas & Temple Services in One App
records.description: Sri Karya Sidhi Ganapathi is the official temple app that brings temple services closer to devotees. Book Pujaris for poojas and religious ceremonies, access astrology services, book temple events, chant Ganapathi mantras with a built-in counter, explore Temple Bazaar, view temple updates and photos, and manage your bookings—all from one convenient app.

records.name: Taskly
records.tagline: Taskly — Just send it.
records.description: Information is everywhere. Tasks shouldn’t be. An assignment. A deadline. A message. A PDF. A voice note. You receive it, then manually turn it into something you need to remember. Taskly makes that friction disappear. Just send the information. Taskly understands it, turns it into a task, and keeps everything organized in one place. No rewriting. No jumping between apps. No relying on memory. Taskly — Just send it.

records.name: Cycolorama by Zester Product Studio
records.tagline: A virtual photo studio for AI images and video
records.description: Cycolorama is a virtual photo and video studio for AI. Click to choose talent, wardrobe, props, sets, lighting, camera and grade, add references, and render with Google Gemini, Veo or any OpenAI-compatible API.

records.name: OwlChart
records.tagline: Live crypto and market charts from raw exchange data
records.description: OwlChart is a charting and market data platform built on raw exchange data. Live charts for crypto, stocks, ETFs, forex, futures and commodities with full history. A liquidity and liquidation heatmap, open interest across 13 exchanges, order book walls across 22 venues, spot ETF flows fund by fund, a pattern scanner with measured win rates and a crypto regulation tracker. It also plugs into Claude, ChatGPT, Grok and Cursor as an AI connector.

records.name: GMC Builder MCP Lite
records.tagline: Read-only MCP tools for GMC Builder on WordPress and Joomla
records.description: Free limited MCP preview for GMC Builder on WordPress and Joomla: four read-only tools list configured sites, probe connections, list up to 10 page metadata items and count nodes in local JSON. Python 3.10+ and separate GMC CMS companions are required. Source available under a limited commercial licence. Editing, publishing and full export/import belong to the separate Pro edition. Pro Base: EUR 49/year, up to 3 sites, 12 months of updates/support, manual renewal.

records.name: Captions Generator
records.tagline: Auto captions, SRT files and free translation—no watermark
records.description: Free AI caption generator with no watermark: add subtitles to any video in seconds. Auto captions in 100 languages, free translation and SRT/VTT downloads.

records.name: Gift Cards Legitimately Using CreditCard
records.tagline: How to Get Free Gift Cards Legitimately Using Credit Card
records.description: Credit card points can become free gift cards in 2026. Learn how to redeem rewards wisely without paying interest or fees.

records.name: Atmospheric Audio Generator
records.tagline: Free browser-based instrument, sampler and multitracker
records.description: AAG combines a playable instrument, effects, sampler and multitrack recorder in a single free browser-based environment. What makes it different is the way these tools are designed for experimentation rather than trying to replicate a traditional DAW. Creating and shaping sounds, sampling audio, building layered pieces and exporting the results can all be done from a single browser page. AAG includes an interactive first-use tour and optional tooltips to assist user onboarding.

records.name: Timecard 
records.tagline: Screen Time alternative that prints your day from the notch
records.description: A screen time tracker for Mac: time per app and website, history kept forever, and your day printed as a timecard every evening. No account, 100% local.

records.name: BP Builder
records.tagline: Your 5-year business plan, built through a conversation
records.description: Building a financial plan means days in a spreadsheet, or paying someone to do it. BP Builder does it through a conversation. An assistant interviews you about your business, adapting to your model and sector. A calculation engine turns that into a full 5-year plan: P&L, cash flow, balance sheet, debt schedule, break-even. Benchmarks across 30 industries fill the gaps. Export to Excel in one click: 10 sheets, 6 charts, live formulas your accountant can audit.

records.name: It's a Numbers Game
records.tagline: Job hunting shouldn't be this difficult!
records.description: If you're out of work and applying to dozens of roles, you know the drill. retype your name, address, phone and work history on every single form. It's a numbers game (itsanumbersgame.xyz) fills those twenty fields from your saved profile, logs each job on a tracking board, and warns you when you've already applied somewhere. Import your resume, add the Chrome extension, and spend your energy on the applications instead of the paperwork. Free forever.

records.name: One Design
records.tagline: One design, endless outputs.
records.description: Most image tools do one job and want your files on their server. One Design is 19 tools in one place, and nothing leaves your device: every tool runs in the browser. Resize for every channel, compress, cut out, watermark, blur faces, redact screenshots, make favicons and App Store shots. Save your brand once and it's there in every tool. Send results straight to the next tool. Coming soon: 15+ more tools, and Workflows to chain them and run a whole batch in one go. Free while in beta.

records.name: ata-validator
records.tagline: Fast, correct JSON Schema validation for JavaScript
records.description: ata is a JSON Schema validator for JavaScript. It passes the whole official test suite and ranks first in all six validation and parsing tables on schemabenchmarks.dev. Errors say what is wrong and where, down to line and column. It runs where code generation is blocked, such as Cloudflare Workers, and its pattern engine is linear-time, so one crafted string cannot stall a server. With the bundler plugin, new Validator(schema) compiles away to a few KB.

records.name: Arkveda Herbals
records.tagline: Arrkveda Herbals – Ayurveda for Everyday Wellness
records.description: Arkveda Herbals brings authentic Ayurvedic wisdom into modern living through carefully crafted herbal formulations. Inspired by classical Ayurvedic traditions and botanicals such as Karela, Jamun, Methi, Gudmar and Amla, our products are prepared in small batches with a strong focus on purity, quality and transparency. Proudly made in India and independently tested for safety and purity.

records.name: CubexSoft MDaemon Converter
records.tagline: All-in-One Solution to Convert MDaemon User Profiles
records.description: CubexSoft MDaemon Converter is an all-rounder solution to help users convert MDaemon emails, contacts, calendars, notes etc. to 20+ saving options. The Export Tool allows to convert MDaemon user profiles to PST, EML, PDF, MBOX, DOC, MSG, TXT, HTML, Office 365, Outlook.com, Gmail, IMAP Server, Thunderbird, Windows Live Mail, Zimbra, etc. without any data loss.

records.name: Grasp
records.tagline: Free workout planner that builds sessions around your gear
records.description: Grasp plans each workout around the equipment you have, at the gym, at home or in a hotel, and sets your weights from what you lifted last time. 600+ animated exercises, one-tap swaps when a machine is taken, superset suggestions that save 5-10 minutes, routines, a recovery map and an interval timer. Free with no ads and no subscription, works offline, in 15 languages.

records.name: Flow by Aivolut
records.tagline: Turn your WordPress blog into an automated growth engine
records.description: Your blog runs itself. Flow researches keywords, writes SEO articles, and publishes directly to WordPress automatically. Built for bloggers, marketers, and agencies, Flow goes beyond AI writing by creating connected content clusters that build topical authority and drive long-term organic growth. No prompts, no copy-paste, no content calendar headaches.

records.name: Swift-Slide
records.tagline: Turn NotebookLM slides into editable PPTX, design intact
records.description: NotebookLM (now Gemini Notebook) makes great slides, then hands you an image you can't edit. Swift-Slide turns them, plus scanned docs and image-only PDFs, into real PPTX with editable text and the original design intact. What's different: AI lifts only the text and restores the background underneath, instead of regenerating the slide. A browser editor then lets you rewrite text, brush over leftovers to repair the background, and restore lost logos. 10 free pages, no card required.

records.name: rdsql
records.tagline: psql for Aurora, over the RDS Data API
records.description: rdsql is a psql-style terminal client for Aurora that talks to the RDS Data API over HTTPS. You don't need a VPN, bastion host, or SSH tunnel. It has an interactive REPL, \d to describe tables, table/JSON/CSV/HTML output, and named connections. Free and MIT-licensed.

records.name: Resell-io
records.tagline: The reseller's toolkit for Vinted, eBay and Depop
records.description: Resell-io is for people who resell second-hand items. A Chrome extension fills your Vinted and eBay listings in one click, in your own browser session. Quick buy tells you the most you should pay at the thrift shop, every sale shows its real profit after fees, and you get your own shop with zero commission. 14-day free trial.

records.name: TV Graphs
records.tagline: Episode rating charts for every TV series
records.description: TV Graphs is a universal SwiftUI app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac that allows users to browse TV series with per-season episode rating charts, favourites synced via iCloud, and AI recommendations on Apple's Private Cloud Compute. Powered by The Movie Database, TV Graphs provides an easy and efficient way to track and enjoy your favourite TV shows without any backend or tracking.

records.name: PDF Editor AI – All PDF Tools
records.tagline: Edit, Convert & Manage PDFs with AI
records.description: PDF Editor AI – All PDF Tools is your all-in-one PDF toolkit for editing, merging, splitting, compressing, converting, and managing documents. Convert PDF to Word, images to PDF, extract pages, reorder pages, rotate documents, and more. With AI-powered features, you can work with your PDFs smarter and faster. Perfect for students, professionals, businesses, freelancers, and everyday document needs. Simple, powerful, and convenient PDF tools in one app.

records.name: Sooveryn
records.tagline: An AI team that remembers all your projects
records.description: Sooveryn gives your AI coding tool a team of AI personas that remembers your projects: your decisions, your rules, what you did yesterday. Before a big choice, the team can debate it if you want, and give you a verdict. Encrypted at rest, hosted in France. I'm a solo developer and this is my first launch :) I hope you'll find a use for it.

records.name: Valorx Wave
records.tagline: Grid Editing & Mass Updates - Spreadsheet Inline Editor
records.description: Edit thousands of Salesforce records in seconds with Wave's spreadsheet UI. Bulk editing, cross-object updates, and Excel features—all inside Salesforce. Get work done fast in Salesforce. Prompt it. Edit in a grid.

records.name: TrackingWArc
records.tagline: First Ever Winter Arc Tracking Platform
records.description: Winter Arc 2026 Stop using distraction-filled productivity apps. Winter Arc is a 90-day discipline system inspired by vintage field notebooks. Features: 90-days habit matrix, quick daily logger, community accountability wall, printable ledger export, and offline cloud sync. Motto: "Don't chase perfection. Track the habit, learn from the day, and show up again." Enlist now at https://trackingwarc.netlify.app/

records.name: iLoveText
records.tagline: All your everyday text tools in one place
records.description: iLoveText provides fast, free online text tools for counting, cleaning, formatting, converting, extracting, comparing, and analyzing text.

records.name: BioReport
records.tagline: Privacy-first personal health data platform that uses AI
records.description: Track blood tests and biomarkers over time with privacy-first BioReport. Import lab results, organize health data, and understand long-term trends.

records.name: Extrovert
records.tagline: Run LinkedIn outreach from your agent
records.description: Extrovert finds prospects, suggests who to comment on or DM today, and prepares drafts in your voice. Review in 20 minutes a day, or hand the whole job to your Claude.

records.name: Cryptoindex.ai
records.tagline: Discover and compare crypto indices in one place
records.description: Explore crypto indices, compare market benchmarks, and track sentiment in one place. Cryptoindex.ai brings together live data, market indicators, and independent research to help you understand the market beyond individual coins. Want your own mix? Build and share a custom index with Cryptoindex.pro.

records.name: Nexlink
records.tagline: Free AI-Powered SEO Toolkit for Audits & Backlinks
records.description: Nexlink analyzes your site and keyword, then hands you a plain-English SEO plan: backlink opportunities, on-page fixes, and outreach copy. Free to start.

records.name: Evidebus
records.tagline: The community-driven public transit directory for India
records.description: A unified platform providing accurate bus routes, schedules, and fares across India. We solve the fragmentation of Indian transit data by combining official open transit feeds (GTFS) with crowdsourced inputs from daily commuters. Find your route, track schedules, and help the community keep transit data fresh.

records.name: ChartJudge
records.tagline: AI second opinion on your forex chart, backed by real data
records.description: ChartJudge gives you an AI second opinion on the chart you already have open. Paste a screenshot from TradingView, MetaTrader, cTrader or your broker app and get trend, levels with prices, patterns, two scenarios and a trade idea with entry, stop, targets and R:R, or setups to wait for. On 28 FX pairs and gold, the Forex Sentiment engine adds what no screenshot shows: retail positioning, a five-factor signal, real price levels and the calendar. 10 free credits, no card.

records.name: 3M chemical-resistant masks
records.tagline: Safer protection against dust and chemical vapors
records.description: In increasingly polluted environments containing various hazardous substances, wearing chemical-resistant masks is essential for protecting workers’ respiratory health. Let’s explore this type of mask with Thien Bang in the article below.

records.name: SpeakText: Voice Transcriber
records.tagline: Offline speech-to-text. Your audio never leaves your phone.
records.description: Every tool I tried wanted the upload first. SpeakText does the whole job on the phone: MP4, M4A, MP3 or WAV in, word-level-timed SRT subtitles or plain TXT out. Voice activity detection, punctuation restoration and inference all run locally on sherpa-onnx. 35 languages, no cloud API, works in airplane mode. It keeps running with the screen locked and resumes if Android kills it. Editing a subtitle line seeks the player to that moment. 3-day free trial.

records.name: Ranktune
records.tagline: Track AI visibility, citations, and referral traffic
records.description: Track how your brand appears across AI search, see which AI platforms are sending traffic to your website, and uncover opportunities to improve your visibility. Ranktune combines AI visibility monitoring, citation tracking, referral traffic analytics, and content optimization in one platform.

records.name: fetchvid.xyz
records.tagline: Fast and privacy-first online video downloader
records.description: fetchvid.xyz is a privacy-first, lightweight web utility engineered for instant online video extraction. Built entirely on Nuxt 4 (Server-Side Rendering) and self-hosted via an optimized Plesk architecture, it processes public media links into high-quality MP4 or M4A formats. Featuring near-zero tracking, active input validation, and an edge-cached multilingual structure for global speeds.

records.name: Pondly
records.tagline: Practice the judgment side of data-science interviews
records.description: Pondly is a mock interviewer for data scientists, data analysts, ML engineers and AI engineers. You talk through a real interview question. It follows up on what you just said. You leave with four ratings taken from your own words.

records.name: PickPDF
records.tagline: Edit PDFs for free. Your files stay on your device.
records.description: Edit PDFs in your browser without uploading them. PickPDF lets you change existing text, redact content, sign documents, fill forms, merge pages and run OCR on scans. Use the built-in on-device AI to summarize and explain your PDF. Start free with no account. Desktop apps are available for Windows, macOS and Linux, plus Chrome and Edge extensions. Optional external AI connections send context to your chosen provider.

records.name: Dueply
records.tagline: Check if your delayed or cancelled flight pays up to €600
records.description: Check for free whether you may be owed up to €600 for a delayed or cancelled flight in the EU, UK or Turkey. Enter the flight number and date: Dueply drafts the letter to the airline, with no commission.

records.name: NEXUS VIRTUAL GPU SUITE
records.tagline: Compute & Raster Acceleration Core
records.description: Run heavy AI pipelines, render complex 3D timelines, and accelerate dense graphics workloads natively across host CPU hardware frameworks. Eliminate unrecoverable out-of-memory application crashes using our uncapped Infinite Virtual VRAM System Memory Pooling engine.

records.name: FungalNailTest.com

records.description: At-home toenail fungus DNA test kit, shipped across Canada. Results reviewed by a licensed Canadian podiatrist with over 50 years of experience, registered in New Brunswick. Results in 4–14 days. Contact: support@fungalnailtest.com

records.description: Speed up your job application process with Job Assist — the AI-powered assistant for resume scoring and CV scoring, ATS-ready resume rewrites and job-specific CV rewrites, job detail extraction, tailored cover letters, application tracking, and interview coaching. Free 3-day trial.

records.name: AYAWORD

records.description: AYAWORD is an Android Islamic quiz app for all ages. Explore questions about the Quran, prophets, companions, Seerah, Islamic ethics, places and general knowledge. Play word puzzles, multiple-choice and true/false challenges, earn points and progress through levels.

records.name: Kinético
records.tagline: Motion graphics videos from one sentence, made by AI
records.description: Type what you want to say, or upload your voice, screenshots and product URL, and the AI animates a finished motion graphics video: launches, explainers, data stories, logo reveals, social loops and full 45-second product showreels. 11 templates with real example videos, 20 visual styles, changes by chat and a community gallery where you can reuse the brief behind any video. First video free.

records.name: bbradar.io
records.tagline: Find better bug bounty targets before everyone else
records.description: bbradar.io brings bug bounty discovery into one place. Search and filter 1,500+ bounty-eligible programs across 25+ platforms and Self-Hosted Programs by rewards, scope, report activity, technology and more. Use Opportunity Scores to surface lower-competition targets, track newly launched programs, and connect the API or MCP directly to your AI agent and hunting workflow.

records.name: Vessel Class Finder
records.tagline: Check any ship's class status by IMO, via API or in Claude
records.description: A free lookup and JSON API for the IACS Vessels in Class dataset. IACS only publishes this as a ZIP/CSV download; we refresh it weekly. Check up to 100 ships per request, or ask Claude directly through our MCP connector. Free: 100 lookups/month, paid plans from $49.

records.name: GreenOrb Statistics
records.tagline: Self-hosted WordPress analytics that itemises bot traffic
records.description: GreenOrb Statistics is a WordPress analytics plugin that keeps visitor data in your own database. It shows what your traffic is made of: known bots are filtered out, a daily scan flags visitors that behave like bots, and a receipt itemises what was removed. The free version includes live visitors, UTM campaigns, click tracking, visitor journeys and email reports, and can run with zero cookies. Pro adds WooCommerce reports, goals, form tracking, Core Web Vitals and Ask AI.

records.name: Diskscape
records.tagline: See what fills your Mac's disk, as one map
records.description: Diskscape draws your whole disk as one treemap. The biggest folder is the biggest box, so whatever is eating your space is the first thing you see. It scans about 200,000 files a second, lists node_modules, Xcode DerivedData, simulator caches and old large files under Worth a look, and its sizes match Finder, with no double-counted APFS volumes. Native Swift, sandboxed, nothing leaves your Mac. Free to scan; Move to Trash is a subscription after 7 days of use.

records.name: Revup
records.tagline: Describe your promotion and AI builds and runs it
records.description: Describe your promotion and RevAssist, Revup's AI assistant, builds it in seconds. Create forms, contests, sweepstakes, instant wins, surveys, and more. Every response, entry, referral, and purchase enriches one profile per participant, helping you understand your audience and build lasting relationships.

records.name: Post

Rain falls inside the island. No account, no telemetry, and exactly two network requests — both switchable. Open source (MIT).

records.name: CompactForm
records.tagline: Drag & Drop Form Builder for Contact Form 7
records.description: Build Contact Form 7 forms by dragging and dropping fields. Add layouts, style each field, set conditions and autofill email templates without writing shortcodes.

Portrait for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, or landscape for YouTube, up to five minutes. Plus free 3D song visualizers, and AI song generation from a description or your own lyrics.

records.name: Reptune
records.tagline: Transfer Pricing Software & Services
records.description: Reptune is the transfer pricing platform built and used by TP experts. Local Files, Master File and CbCR are automated and localised, and each year's setup rolls forward. Chosen by 150+ multinationals and ISO 27001 certified.

Your files stay on your local network, making BrowserDrop a simple and private way to move files between Android and your computer.

records.name: petntrip

records.name: Psychology Engine, Soul Cleanse

records.description: Reactool.AI turns your idea into a live app, website, or online store. Just describe what you want: we build and deploy it in the background. No code, no files, no setup. Bolt and Lovable are great for developers. Reactool is for everyone else: entrepreneurs, small businesses, and creators. This is v1. It's not perfect, but it does the job, and we're launching early to build the next version with you. Try it and tell us what you think!

records.name: Ne.app
records.tagline: Systems Software PDK
records.description: A Build It Yourself Distribution for Enterprise and Individuals power-users.

records.name: FormPilot AI
records.tagline: Autofill job applications & web forms in seconds with AI
records.description: Never fill out repetitive job applications, KYC verifications, or complex web forms by hand again. FormPilot AI matches your saved profile, resume, and preferences to any form field instantly using lightweight client-side AI. 1-Click universal smart form fill across any domain. Generates tailored cover letters on the fly. 100% private: all credentials and profile data stay strictly in your browser. Built on Google Manifest V3 for instant speed and low memory usage.

records.name: Milago
records.tagline: The AI Notetaker That Doesn't Stop at Notes
records.description: Milago captures your meeting (browser, Windows app with no bot in the call, file upload, or a notetaker bot for Zoom, Meet and Teams), then writes the transcript with speaker labels, summary, decisions and action items. You approve them, each lands on an Action Board with an owner and due date, and goes out to Jira, Linear, GitHub, Notion, Slack, Teams or as a prompt for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Search and ask across every meeting, also via a hosted MCP server.

records.name: Infraova
records.tagline: The operational layer for email infrastructure at scale.
records.description: Most email infrastructure tools stop at alerts: they say something is wrong, and your team investigates, fixes and verifies it by hand. Infraova closes that loop. It monitors 30 checks per domain, prioritizes what matters and, for the most critical issues, proposes the exact DNS fix. You approve in Slack, email or the dashboard. Infraova then applies it through your DNS provider, verifies the live record and keeps a full history. The decision stays human. The operational work doesn't.

records.name: SofaDeck
records.tagline: Your phone as a Stream Deck and voice remote for PC & Mac
records.description: Free tray app for Windows and Mac. Scan a QR code and your phone becomes a grid of big buttons (apps, hotkeys, media, macros) plus a push-to-talk voice remote. No phone app, no account, LAN-only.

records.name: CronWatch
records.tagline: Cron fails silently. This doesn’t.
records.description: CronWatch records every run of your scheduled jobs in your own database, and speaks up when one is missed, fails, gets stuck, runs slow or costs too much. It is a library, not a service. No server to run, no account to make, and run history that stays in your database. An alert carries the error and the last lines of output to the channels you pick, and to Anthropic only if you turn on triage. MIT licensed.

records.name: Tiny Store
records.tagline: Offer local preorders & pick ups anywhere
records.description: When the world is going crazy over AI and world domination, at Tiny Store we want to empower local economies and human-made goods. Our newest update features our refreshed preorder and flexible pick-up experience, so if you're a maker or small business owner who sells from home, at markets, or move around in craftfairs - tiny is built for you!

records.name: Mailbird Next
records.tagline: One calm inbox for every email account, on Windows and Mac
records.description: Mailbird Next is a desktop email client for Windows and Mac, rebuilt on one codebase so it is the same app on both. Every account in one unified inbox, native calendar and contacts, and apps like WhatsApp and Asana in a panel beside your mail. Privacy Hub blocks trackers and remote images. An MCP server lets you connect Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor to your inbox; off by default, your mail stays on your computer. Free for one account, no time limit. Android app in beta now, iPhone coming soon.

records.name: LinkNest
records.tagline: Create a beautiful link-in-bio tool
records.description: LinkNest helps creators, influencers, freelancers and businesses create a personalized link-in-bio page where they can showcase their social profiles, websites, products, content and more — all from one simple URL.

records.name: OnCloud
records.tagline: Commerce, POS, Mercado Libre and AI in one platform
records.description: OnCloud unifies ecommerce, POS, ARCA invoicing, inventory, purchasing and cash management for Argentine retailers, with AI sales agents for WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook and optional Mercado Libre operations.

records.name: PixelBid
records.tagline: LED wall quotes with the engineering already done
records.description: Pitch and wall size in; cabinet layout, power circuits, data runs per processor port, viewing distances, drawings and a client quote out. For LED integrators and rental companies. Free, no account to start. 59 cabinets, NovaStar processors, 7 languages.

records.name: Naxern
records.tagline: AI ad creatives for local service businesses in seconds
records.description: Naxern is your AI marketing manager for Meta ads. It creates the campaign, generates the creatives, monitors live performance, and keeps optimising — so you're not the one managing Ads Manager.

records.name: OpenPPC
records.tagline: Google Ads audits, made simple
records.description: I audit Google Ads accounts for a living, and the audit market is broken. Anyone can charge anything for a PDF nobody can check, and AI now writes audits in seconds with numbers that aren't in the account. So I built OpenPPC: run a free audit of your own export, where code computes every figure, or paste any audit and see which numbers hold up. Open source and read-only, and in the app your export never leaves your computer.

records.name: GroceryBilling
records.tagline: Free grocery POS with inventory and QR shopping
records.description: GroceryBilling is free-to-start grocery billing and POS software for grocery stores and kirana shops. Combine barcode checkout, separate Total Stock and Shelf Stock, Shelf QR Scan & Buy, digital baskets and direct online ordering in one browser-based platform. The Free plan includes 300 items, 50 shopping baskets, two billing stations and unlimited bills. Co-founder: Kirti Dixit Ojha.

records.name: GlowHalo Utility APIs
records.tagline: Tiny web-check APIs: DNS, headers, CORS, email & more
records.description: A growing set of small, fast utility APIs on Cloudflare Workers: link previews, WHOIS/RDAP and DNS lookups, email validation, security-header grades, CORS and robots.txt checks. Free tiers; each one is a single GET call.

records.name: Hustle BS Detector
records.tagline: Score any money-making pitch 0-100 for BS before you pay
records.description: Hustle BS Detector scores any make-money-online pitch 0-100 for BS, flags the red flags (fake urgency, unrealistic income claims, vague "secret systems"), and calls out anything that actually looks legit. Paste text or a URL, runs on your own Anthropic key, nothing stored anywhere but your own device. Windows + Android, one-time $7.99.

records.name: Shake Releases Module
records.tagline: Know if your software is safe to ship
records.description: Every other tool hands you a pile of tickets and leaves the call to you. Shake's new Releases module changes that. For each version of your app, you get a release health score built from six signals: crash-free sessions, endpoints health, network traffic speed, resolution rate, MTTR, and testing coverage. One number. One verdict. Ship or don't.

records.name: Contomatix LLM SEO Checker
records.tagline: See which AI crawlers your robots.txt allows or blocks
records.description: Paste your robots.txt and see, bot by bot, whether GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and other AI crawlers are allowed, blocked or unmentioned. Free, no signup, runs in your browser.

records.name: Ghost Regex
records.tagline: Regex in VS Code — diagrams, ReDoS, live preview
records.description: Railroad diagrams, Explain with AST, ReDoS detector, unit tests, and Preview on real files — all in one VS Code extension. The unique part: point it at an actual file, type a regex, see matches highlighted in the content. Plus a ReDoS detector that catches nested quantifiers and suggests a fix: (a+)+$ → (a+)$. 94 snippets, code generation for 5 languages. Free is fully functional, Pro is $6/mo.

records.name: Linewhale
records.tagline: Compare odds and beat the books for free with Linewhale.com
records.description: Real-time sports betting odds comparison across 100+ sportsbooks and prediction markets in 8 regions. Free and paid tools guaranteed to save you money and help you beat the books!

records.name: Image Fixer
records.tagline: Fix product images for ecommerce, right in your browser
records.description: Resize and standardise product images for ecommerce. Create consistent square images in batcheImage Fixer is a free browser-based tool for preparing product images for ecommerce. Resize and standardize up to 30 images at once, control backgrounds and product sizing, and export consistent, store-ready images. No sign-up and images stay on your device.s of up to 30. Free, private and no sign-up.

records.name: OMNILION Business Network
records.tagline: The business network for the accommodation ecosystem
records.description: A global B2B network for the businesses and professionals behind short-term rentals, vacation rentals and serviced accommodation. Discover operators, cleaning companies, linen and laundry suppliers, maintenance partners and hospitality providers. Create a business or professional profile, build connections, exchange messages and share updates. Plans: FREE, Professional £29/month and Operations £69/month.

records.name: RefreshYourMac
records.tagline: A Mac cleaner that measures first and removes safely
records.description: I built it after my own Mac kept running out of space and every cleaner I tried offered one big "junk" button without saying what each item would cost me to lose. So this one measures first. Scanning is free: lists what it found before you pay anything. There's no memory purge and no malware scanner. Instead it shows how much memory is genuinely spare, and reports XProtect's real signature version and Gatekeeper's state, from your Mac. No account and no telemetry. €39.99 once, or €19.99 a year.

records.name: AxioAPI
records.tagline: One API key for all the APIs your app needs
records.description: Access SMS, temp mail, email validation, proxies and social scrapers with one API key and shared credits. Start building for free with 200 demo credits.

records.name: North Noir
records.tagline: AI-drawn video with any LLM. Free with your own API key
records.description: North Noir turns one prompt into an AI-drawn video: the LLM you choose draws every frame in code, redraws its mistakes, then you edit it on a real timeline with narration, music and sound effects. Free with your own API key.

records.name: Call Recorder: Voice, Calls & SOS
records.tagline: Recorder with SOS Safety
records.description: We developed Call Recorder, an Android app that combines voice recording, call recording, and an SOS emergency feature in one simple app. Key Features • Voice recording • Call recording • SOS contact • 5-shake SOS activation • Automatic 12-second SOS recording • Send SOS audio to the saved contact • Simple and easy-to-use interface Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.myqrmart.call_recorder&pcampaignid=web_share

records.name: NotepadWeb - Private Encrypted Notes
records.tagline: Share encrypted notes with anyone
records.description: NotepadWeb is a simple, secure online notepad for quickly creating, editing, and saving notes directly in your browser. No account is required; you can just write, save, and access your notes when you need them. Note content is encrypted before it is sent to the server, and it cannot be deciphered without the private key. The notes can also be auto-deleted based on total number of view or total days passed, based on the note settings. Notes are kept for maximum 365 days.

records.name: Helpdesk
records.tagline: Turn Every Customer Conversation Into an Opportunity.
records.description: Free live chat, ticketing and help center for your website. See what visitors type before they send, spot upset customers, and watch where people click with built-in heatmaps.

records.name: Dijla Media Player
records.tagline: Modern, lightweight media player for Windows
records.description: Dijla Media Player is a modern, lightweight Windows player built for high performance. Key Features: • Interactive timeline hover preview • High-precision frame snapshot capture • Advanced subtitle search & audio track sync • A-B repeat looping & speed control (0.25x - 4.0x) • Always on Top (PiP) & chapter navigation • Minimalist dark UI with low RAM/CPU usage

records.name: RespiraDebt
records.tagline: 8 free debt calculators — no sign-up, embed anywhere
records.description: RespiraDebt puts 8 free debt calculators in one place — no sign-up, no paywall, nothing stored. Debt payoff (snowball vs. avalanche, with your real debt-free date), settlement, consolidation, credit-card payoff, debt-to-income, balance transfer, windfall payoff, and credit utilization. Run real numbers for your situation in seconds — and if you run a finance or budgeting site, embed any calculator for free. Estimates to help you plan, not financial advice.

records.name: Adoptiv
records.tagline: The Telephony-First CRM Built for High-Velocity Sales Teams
records.description: Adoptiv is a telephony-first CRM that brings calling, CRM, automation, and AI together in one platform. Built for sales teams, BPOs, contact centers, and other phone-heavy businesses, Adoptiv combines predictive, power, and preview dialing with CRM, call flows, sequences, reporting, compliance, and AI-powered call intelligence. It helps teams reduce manual data entry, simplify their technology stack, and turn conversations into actionable customer data.

records.name: Finjobsly
records.tagline: The fintech job board that knows what you're really worth
records.description: Finjobsly is a job board for people who work in fintech. We list 2,600+ live roles from verified employers in payments, RegTech, WealthTech, crypto, DeFi and AI in finance. Salary figures come from real postings and offers rather than surveys, so you know what a role pays before the first call. Upload your CV and in under a minute you'll see how it scores against those roles and what's missing. You apply directly to the employer. If you're hiring, AI Scout searches our candidate pool for you.

records.name: TUlon
records.tagline: Plan group trips, budgets and expenses together
records.description: TUlon is an all-in-one group travel planner that keeps the whole trip in one place. Build shared itineraries, manage a group budget, track expenses in multiple currencies, split costs between travelers, and automatically see who owes whom. Everyone in the group stays in sync - from planning the trip to settling the final expenses.

records.name: SocialAI Teleprompter
records.tagline: Free online teleprompter that follows your voice
records.description: A free teleprompter in your browser that scrolls as you speak. Paste or import a script (Word, PDF, text), press Start and read: it waits when you pause, ignores ad-libs and catches up if you skip a line. All free with no sign-up: unlimited voice tracking, webcam recording with no watermark (never uploaded), mirror and upside-down modes, countdown, colours and share links. Also free: a speaking speed test and a speech time calculator.

records.name: TiltMaze
records.tagline: Tilt your phone, roll the ball, escape 225 3D mazes
records.description: A physics labyrinth in your pocket. Tilt your phone to roll a steel ball through 225 levels across 15 hand-painted worlds, each adding a new twist: wind gusts, fragile ice, magnets, springs, conveyor belts and walls that move while you play. Every bounce and slide is real physics, not scripted. Build and play your own mazes with the level editor, beat your best times and stars, and play fully offline in 12 languages.

records.name: Hopvote
records.tagline: Live polls your audience joins by scanning a QR code
records.description: Hopvote turns any meeting, class or talk into a conversation. Show a QR code, and everyone answers from their phone: no app, no account. Polls, quizzes with a leaderboard, word clouds, ratings and audience Q&A, with results live on the big screen. Each phone reads the questions in its own language, AI drafts your questions, and it works in PowerPoint, Canva and Google Slides. Free up to 80 participants, then 5 EUR a month with no yearly plan.

records.name: FutureSync: AI Post Creator
records.tagline: Create AI Posts with tranding topics, hooks, drafts and more
records.description: FutureSync combines AI-powered content creation with practical networking tools to help you turn ideas into polished professional posts. - AI Post Creator - Generate Attention-Grabbing Hooks - Discover Trending Topics - Flexible AI Models - Digital Business Card & QR Tools Turn an idea into a post, find your next topic, save drafts and manage your professional presence with FutureSync.

records.name: Omax Tech
records.tagline: Custom software, SaaS, AI and AWS DevOps engineering partner
records.description: Omax Tech (founded 2025) is a custom software and SaaS engineering partner with offices in Allen, TX, Dubai and Karachi. We help startups and mid-market teams ship AI-ready products, scalable MVPs, AWS DevOps and senior staff augmentation with US-overlapping hours. Team of almost 80; 26–50 clients; 50+ projects delivered. AWS Select Tier Services Partner.

records.name: Mahraj Landscaping | Indoor Plants
records.tagline: Bring Nature Indoors with our modern indoor plants
records.description: Turn everyday rooms into fresh, inviting spaces with indoor plants that add natural beauty, soft greenery, and a lively touch to your home or office.

records.name: Gift Card
records.tagline: Great products and get a chance to win a $1,000 Gift Card
records.description: Looking for exciting new products, useful tools, and exclusive rewards? Join our Amazon Gift Card giveaway and discover innovative products from around the web. https://t.co/Jf25Ng0PAM 🎁 Prize: $1,000 Amazon Gift Card 🚀 Discover new products 💡 Explore useful tools and services 🏆 Enter for a chance to win 📢 Share with friends and fellow product hunters Important: This promotion is independently organized and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Amazon unless explicitly stated.

records.name: Mobilegoo
records.tagline: Know your phone’s worth. Turn it into value.
records.description: Know what your old phone is worth. Turn it into value. 📱 Get a device-specific valuation based on model, storage and condition. 💰 Discover your phone’s resale value before you sell. ⚡ Sell your used smartphone online through a simple, convenient process. 🔒 Transparent and hassle-free from valuation to sale.

records.name: ellô-wp
records.tagline: Run your whole WordPress + Elementor site from your AI
records.description: ellô-wp connects your AI (Claude, ChatGPT…) to your WordPress sites so it does the real work: build and edit Elementor pages, change texts, manage media, menus and WooCommerce, and even install and configure plugins and themes. Unlike editor-only AI tools, it drives the whole site, not just the page builder, and it works on Elementor Free and Pro.

records.name: vocalrange
records.tagline: Find your vocal range and voice type in 40 seconds
records.description: Sing your lowest note, then your highest, and hold each for 2 seconds. You get your range, your voice type, the famous singers who share it, songs that fit, and a card you can share. A note only counts if you hold it for 2 seconds, so a breath or a squeak never becomes your top note. It runs in your browser. No account, no email, and the audio never leaves your device. The test and the card are free; a paid setlist lists every song that fits your range, with the key to sing it in.

records.name: ClipFlow — Creator OS
records.tagline: AI Creator OS with a free video engine
records.description: ClipFlow is a content-business command center — pipeline, sponsor CRM, analytics — plus a real AI Shorts engine most templates don't ship. Type a topic, it scripts it (Groq), generates visuals/narration (free, keyless), then assembles a downloadablewebm video client-side, zero API cost. Also: idea vault with viral scoring, script studio, content calendar, repurpose tool for platform rewrites. Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, Radix UI. By a freelance dev (3+ yrs, 40+ sites shipped).

records.name: The Atlas 177 places worth travelling to
records.tagline: A curated guide to 177 places worth the flight
records.description: The Atlas is a curated guide to 177 places worth travelling to. Browse the destinations in one place and find your next trip. Built as a personal project and published with Netlify. Feedback welcome!

records.name: InfraNest
records.tagline: Manage infrastructure across all your providers
records.description: Your domains are at one registrar, DNS somewhere else, servers across multiple clouds, and monitoring in yet another tool. InfraNest brings them together. Connect the providers you already use and automatically discover your infrastructure — no migration required. Manage domains and DNS, monitor servers, uptime and SSL certificates, create status pages, find security issues and automate recurring tasks from one dashboard. Free to start, no credit card required.

records.name: Hotelado
records.tagline: Compare hotels, rooms and booking terms worldwide
records.description: Find a hotel that fits your trip. Hotelado brings worldwide hotel search, maps, room details, guest reviews and live offers into one place. Compare meal plans, total stay prices and cancellation terms before booking. Explore destination guides and book as a guest.

records.name: Nothing Hours
records.tagline: A place to do absolutely nothing. Together.
records.description: Nothing Hours is a collective internet experiment in doing absolutely nothing. Stay on the page and your time is added to a shared global counter. The goal is to collectively do nothing for 1,000,000 hours. There are no accounts, feeds, likes, rankings or achievements. Just a personal timer, a global timer, and other people doing nothing with you. No ads. No feed. No purpose.

records.name: Scanwork
records.tagline: Print the QR code once. Change where it goes, anytime.
records.description: Scanwork gives you dynamic QR codes you print once and redirect anytime. Put one on a menu, window, package or business card, then change where it points from a simple dashboard when your menu, offer or hours change. No reprinting. - Your brand color, logo in the centre, rounded or square modules - Daily scan counts per code - Print-ready PNG, and SVG on paid plans - Free plan; paid from €9/month

records.name: Vero
records.tagline: The AI-native workspace for LaTeX, resumes & technical docs.
records.description: Most resume tools give you templates. Vero gives you an AI-native LaTeX workspace. Edit your document with natural-language prompts like ChatGPT, make changes inline, preview instantly, use professional templates, and check your ATS score and all without leaving your workspace. It combines the precision of LaTeX with the speed of AI.

records.name: Quick Order B2B Grid
records.tagline: Spreadsheet-style bulk ordering for B2B & wholesale stores
records.description: Most B2B order forms are just a long list with quantity boxes. Quick Order B2B Grid is a real spreadsheet: sort, filter and resize columns like in Excel. Paste a SKU list from an email, scan barcodes with your phone, upload a messy CSV and it still matches, save templates for orders you place every month, export to XLSX, PDF or XML. Works on Shopify, PrestaShop, WooCommerce and Magento. Built with input from real B2B shop owners, not just a feature checklist.

records.name: api100
records.tagline: One API for 100+ AI models
records.description: api100 gives developers one OpenAI-compatible API to access 100+ AI models from multiple providers. Switch models without rebuilding integrations, test them in Chat Studio, and track usage, tokens, latency, and costs from one place.

records.name: Quota
records.tagline: See your AI usage limits and credits in one place
records.description: Quota is a free, open-source desktop app for keeping track of your AI tools without opening each provider's dashboard. It shows subscription allowances, reset times and API credit balances in your tray or a floating widget. You can add multiple accounts for integrations that support it.

records.name: Daily Devo by PS.Today
records.tagline: A short daily devotional in English, Hindi and Odia
records.description: Daily Devo gives you one short devotional each day: a KJV Scripture passage, a plain-English restatement, and a few minutes of grace-focused reflection. Read it in English, Hindi or Odia, or listen to the audio. Browse past months in the archive, set gentle morning and evening reminders, and share a verse card with friends. No account is needed to read; sign in only if you want to keep your reading rhythm. Built by the PS.Today team for Android.

records.name: ChartsKing
records.tagline: Algo trading signals for NQ, ES & Gold. 24/7 automated.
records.description: ChartsKing delivers 24/7 algorithmic trading signals for NQ, MNQ, ES, MES and Gold futures on TradingView — fully automated to your broker in milliseconds. Unlike other platforms, we show everything: real win rate, real P&L, zero hidden losses. Full transparency dashboard included. Works on full size and micro contracts. Rules based, no emotion, no guesswork. From $19/month. 7-day money back guarantee.

records.name: RawNudge
records.tagline: Describe RAW photo edits in words on your Mac
records.description: Edit RAW photos with words on your Mac, compare AI suggestions, and choose what to apply. Use your ChatGPT account with Codex access—no API key required; plan conditions apply. One-time app purchase; AI service costs are separate.

records.name: MySafeTherapy
records.tagline: Self-help to manage 167 hours in-between therapy sessions
records.description: MySafeTherapy: UK based online therapy platofrm with an aim to become your ecosystem to manage 167 hours in-between therapy sessions.

records.name: Resumify
records.tagline: AI resumes and cover letters, tailored to any job post
records.description: Build a professional, ATS-optimised resume and cover letter with AI in under 3 minutes. Paste a job posting and Resumify tailors your resume, cover letter and keywords to match it, using only your real experience, never fabricated skills. The free ATS checker scores your CV and shows what's missing against any job post. Every purchase includes an editable Word file plus your PDF. Built for UAE, Saudi, Qatar and GCC job seekers. $2.99, one-time.

records.name: Toroid
records.tagline: Conway's Game of Life on a grid that never dies at an edge
records.description: Toroid is Conway's Game of Life on a wrapping board, so gliders never hit a wall. Draw a pattern, press play, watch four rules do the rest. Web, iPhone, iPad, Mac, and a standalone Apple Watch app. No accounts, no network, no ads.

records.name: Wireframe Patterns
records.tagline: 64 website section wireframes with copy-ready HTML/CSS
records.description: A free library of 64 website section wireframes: headers, heroes, pricing, FAQs, forms and more. Each explains why the layout works. Copy the HTML/CSS skeleton, export SVG for Figma, or stack sections into a full-page wireframe. No sign-up.

records.name: RJID
records.tagline: A fast, GPU-rendered Java IDE written in Rust
records.description: RJID (Rust for Java IDE) is a GPU-rendered Java IDE written from scratch in Rust. It recognizes Maven, Gradle, Spring Boot and JavaFX projects and runs or debugs them in one click, with a localhost link when your server starts. Completion with auto-import, quick fixes, refactorings, code generation, a real terminal and a New Project wizard. Early preview for Windows; free for personal and noncommercial use, source on GitHub.

records.name: FitRooted
records.tagline: Source-backed fitness answers and practical next steps
records.description: FitRooted helps beginners and people returning to fitness find a clear starting point. Read source-backed answers about fat loss, strength, nutrition and routines; use free calorie tools; then turn useful next steps into an editable plan. Membership adds AI follow-up questions and weekly reviews. Optional Chinese Wellness content and one-time Digital Kits offer more ways to explore. General fitness education, not medical advice.

records.name: PetVitals
records.tagline: Pet health tracker with an AI assistant that knows your pet
records.description: PetVitals is a calm health notebook for your pet. Log meals, meds and walks from a daily checklist with reminders, keep weight, vaccine and medication records, and track blood glucose and insulin for diabetic cats and dogs. Charts show what is changing, a one-tap PDF report gives your vet the full history, and an AI assistant answers using your pet's own records and says when to see a vet. Dogs, cats, birds, rabbits and more. Free to start, 10 languages.

records.name: Olie Flow AI
records.tagline: Run your whole operation in one AI-powered flow
records.description: Olie turns operations scattered across WhatsApp, spreadsheets and email into a single flow, where every step has an owner, a deadline and a rule. Funnels, public forms, CRM, service desk, automations and AI agents work on the same project, including a conversational AI agent that serves customers on WhatsApp. When someone is late, the platform follows up, not you. Ready-made templates from day one. 30-day free trial, no credit card.

records.name: Currawong Buying Tools
records.tagline: Free tools to compare China quotes and clarify payment terms
records.description: Free, no-signup tools for remote buyers ordering from China. Clarify proforma-invoice terms, compare quotes using quantity and known or missing costs, and organise supplier statements against your documents. Built-in examples let you try the workflow. Inputs stay in your browser. These planning and document tools are separate from paid company-record reports and do not approve suppliers or verify bank ownership.

records.name: Bad Pixel
records.tagline: The desktop pet HR warned you about
records.description: What ya looking at? Get back to work Bad Pixel is a tiny, lazy office-worker pet that lives on your Mac or Windows desktop. Pixeri wanders across your screen while you work, judges you a little, reads your daily fortune, picks your lunch, and keeps a resignation letter ready — just in case. Make a group with up to 4 friends: see each other's pets on your screen, toss them around, send doodle notes that self-destruct, and yes, poop together. No sign-up needed to start.

records.name: VPNStack
records.tagline: The White-Label Ecosystem for Remnawave: 1-Click APK Builder
records.description: Turn your Remnawave panel into a full White-Label VPN service! ⚡ 1-Click Cloud APK Builder: Compile & sign custom Android apps in 1.5 mins. 🎨 100% Server-Driven UI: Dynamic themes and 60 FPS Canvas button animations. 🛡️ Hybrid Failover: Merges primary Remnawave routes with backup VLESS/Marzban nodes. 💬 Live Support Chat: Real-time customer chat & push notifications by device HWID.

records.name: CompressImageWeb
records.tagline: Compress, Convert & Resize Images — Fast, Private & Free
records.description: Your Private Image Toolkit Compress, convert, and resize images directly in your browser. 🔒 Private by Design Images are processed in your browser, not uploaded. 📦 Compress Images Reduce file size while keeping quality. 🔄 Convert Formats Convert JPG, PNG, and WebP easily. 📐 Resize Images Resize to your desired dimensions. 🎯 Target File Size Target 100KB, 200KB, or 500KB. ⚡ Fast & Simple No signup, installation, or setup. 🚀 All-in-One Toolkit Compress. Convert. Resize. Fast, free, and private.
