records.name: Ciao
records.tagline: The AI voice agent that never misses a call
records.description: Ciao is an AI-powered voice agent built for real business conversations. It answers inbound calls, makes outbound calls, qualifies leads, schedules appointments, and handles follow-ups automatically. Ciao understands natural conversations, handles interruptions, and can use your documents, FAQs, and business knowledge to respond accurately. It also supports calling campaigns, website voice widgets, API calling, CRM and calendar integrations, with transcripts and call outcomes.

records.name: Revloy
records.tagline: Stop building Twilio client reports by hand
records.description: If you run Twilio for clients you probably know the routine. Export the logs, build a pivot table, paste the totals into a doc, then start over for the next client. I got tired of it so I built Revloy. You connect Twilio once, it finds every subaccount, and you group them by client. Each client gets a report with their texts, calls, and spend broken out and compared to last month. Share a link, save a PDF, or let it email them on the 1st. From $10/month, 7 day trial.

records.name: QR Code Scanner by Pextume
records.tagline: Smart QR scanner with live camera and low-light detection
records.description: ​Scan complex color QR codes instantly with Pextume's web-based QR scanner. Featuring live camera scanning, auto-detection, low-light flash support, and instant sharing options—all directly in your browser without any app installation.

records.name: TripStow
records.tagline: Your trips and travel stats, built from your booking emails
records.description: Forward your booking emails and TripStow builds your trips. A lifetime travel log, a scratch-off world map, flight stats, badges and live flight alerts.

records.name: Review Mechanic
records.tagline: Get Google reviews without the awkward ask
records.description: Review Mechanic helps local businesses collect authentic Google reviews via WhatsApp — the compliant way. Every customer gets an equal choice to post publicly or send private feedback. compare against top 3 competitors in your area; AI drafts review replies; you approve before anything posts. Free QR tool included.

records.name: Sizecurve
records.tagline: Size curves and reorder plans for apparel, net of returns
records.description: A Shopify app for apparel brands. It builds each style's size curve from demand net of returns, says what to reorder in which sizes, and flags size runs whose core sizes are gone. A size that sold out is counted at the rate it sold while it had stock, not as a size nobody wanted. You set your own supplier lead time, and stock already incoming in Shopify from a purchase order or transfer is subtracted. Read-only: it never writes to your store. $29 a month after a 14-day free trial.

records.name: Cards by Zac Wine
records.tagline: Business cards designed for you, not configured by you.
records.description: Cards is a done-for-you business card system. Send a LinkedIn profile, website, or a few basics; I decide what belongs with AI and design the digital Card with human judgement, QR/contact file, email signature, and print-ready physical card. $149, including the first year live ($29/yr following).

records.name: JobPilot
records.tagline: Automated Job Application Emailer
records.description: Stop copy-pasting the same cold email and resume attachment. Add recruiter / career emails once, and let the system send personalised applications from your own Gmail, track the results, and (in v2) find new recruiter emails for you.

records.name: Siena - Finding Connections For You
records.tagline: Clients, investors, partners, and more, found for you
records.description: Tell Siena a little about what you're looking for and she'll pass it to the Waivly team. Whether you're interested in joining Waivly, looking for a connection, or exploring something specific, she'll make sure your request gets to the right place.

records.name: Formatly
records.tagline: Free privacy-first image tools that run 100% in your browser
records.description: Free privacy-first image toolkit: convert HEIC to JPG, compress, resize, strip EXIF, make PDFs and favicons — 100% in your browser. No uploads, no sign-up.

records.name: PartyVillas — Find Your best Party Venue
records.tagline: Discover villas & farmhouses for parties, stays
records.description: PartyVillas helps you discover verified villas, farmhouses, and private venues for parties, stays, birthdays, pool parties, weddings, and corporate events. Browse real photos, amenities, locations, and pricing to find a venue that fits your group and occasion.

records.name: FFA Connect
records.tagline: Church PWA
records.description: FFA Connect — the Faith Fellowship Aurora app, with interactive sermon notes.

records.name: kivi
records.tagline: You talk, kivi types. Voice dictation for every Mac app
records.description: Hold a key and talk in any Mac app. kivi drops the "um"s, catches it when you change your mind ("Friday, no wait, Thursday"), and formats lists, emails, code and math. It's fast. accurate. everywhere. Works across multiple applications and tabs. It drops the "um"s, catches it when you change your mind ("Friday, no wait, Thursday"), and formats lists, emails and code. Fix a name once and it remembers. Set how you sound per app. Built by Sarvam AI. Free in alpha, macOS 14+.

records.name: veyra
records.tagline: Understand long videos without watching every minute
records.description: Generated by createveyra helps you understand long educational YouTube videos without watching every minute. Paste a YouTube video URL and veyra breaks it into focused 5-minute sections. Each section is analyzed with AI to give you the topic, summary, key points, concepts, and useful resources. The goal is simple: make long videos easier to explore and help you quickly find the parts that matter to you. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Gemma. Open source on GitHub. next app

records.name: Word Counter: Letter Count
records.tagline: Count words, characters, and analyze your text
records.description: Word Counter: Letter Count is a text statistics and analysis app for iPhone and iPad. It provides real-time word, character, sentence, and paragraph counts, along with readability analysis, OCR text extraction, and PDF/TXT export. The app is designed to make checking and analyzing text quick and effortless, with text processing performed locally on the device.

records.name: MullTrade
records.tagline: Copy Telegram trading signals to MT4, MT5 & TradeLocker
records.description: MullTrade links the Telegram channel you choose to your own trading account and places the trades with your settings: fixed lot or % risk, SL/TP, trading hours, daily limits. Optional AI reads free-form messages and screenshots. 3-day free trial.

records.name: Experly
records.tagline: Create personalized programs for every client.
records.description: Experly is the online coaching platform where experts turn their own material into a personalized coaching program for every client, shaped by that client's questionnaire answers and approved by the expert before it ships.

records.name: NAGA5000
records.tagline: game
records.description: NAGA5000 menyediakan informasi top up game, voucher, dan produk digital. Cek game, nominal, dan ketentuan layanan sebelum melanjutkan.

records.name: Leidaro
records.tagline: The Public Transport Navigator for the EU
records.description: Leidaro is the best real-time bus tracker and public transport app for Europe. Track buses, trams, trolleys and metro live across 30 cities. Get accurate bus arrival times, smart transit alerts, and offline maps. Free Android app, no ads, no account.

records.name: Natural Calming Supplement For Horses
records.tagline: Regenerative Hemp for Natural Equine Wellness & Vitality.
records.description: Choose a natural calming supplement for horses with whole-plant hemp and simple ingredients, formulated to support calm behavior, focus, comfort, and mobility.

records.name: Boardit
records.tagline: Six multiplayer games. One room code. No downloads.
records.description: Play six multiplayer games in your browser: Property Rush, Trivia Tavern, Ludo, Snakes & Ladders, Who's the Spy, and Draw and Guess. Open a table, share its five-character code, and guests join without a download or account.

records.name: RecruiterReach
records.tagline: Recruiter mail merge for Gmail + Google Sheets
records.description: RecruiterReach is a Chrome extension for solo recruiters. Keep candidates in the Google Sheet you already use. Write a personalized email, send as yourself from Gmail, and write Sent / Replied / Bounced back to the Sheet. No inbox reading. No tracking pixels. No LinkedIn scraping. Free for 10 people; larger lists coming soon.

records.name: Postcurve
records.tagline: Understand what actually works on X
records.description: See what's working on your X account: every post compared with your own posts at the same age. Free, and stored only in your browser.PostCurve is a free X analytics extension that shows you what actually works on your account. It analyzes your posting history to uncover your best topics, hooks, formats, timing, breakout posts, underperformers, second waves and engagement patterns — directly inside X. No separate dashboard. No X API setup. Just install it and understand your content better.

records.name: Infonic AI Chatbot
records.tagline: AI support chatbot trained on your website and documents
records.description: Infonic AI turns your website pages, posts, PDFs, Word files and text documents into a 24/7 support chatbot. Connect WordPress with a plugin or embed it on any website—no coding or OpenAI API key required. Free plan available.

records.name: Three.js Grassworks
records.tagline: Production-ready procedural grass system for Three.js+WebGPU
records.description: A complete grass system for Three.js and WebGPU, built to make dense, realistic, and performant grass easy to add to your 3D environments. Create expansive grass fields with dynamic wind, terrain interaction, multiple grass styles, and the tools to shape your world exactly the way you want.

records.name: Alertio
records.tagline: Know the moment your DeFi position is at risk.
records.description: Most DeFi tools show you the market. Alertio watches your position in it. Paste any wallet and see how close it is to liquidation, no sign-up. Then set alerts: 58 types across 15 protocols and 12 chains, Ethereum to Solana and TON. Health factors, pegs, liquidations, utilization, funding, sent to Telegram, email or webhook. Read-only: no signing, no approvals, no custody. Risk is banded on each market's own liquidation threshold, not a flat scale. Free to start.

records.name: REPPED by ArtsEnvoy.ai
records.tagline: Build a sustainable creative career w/ an AI artist manager.
records.description: Every creative deserves an artist manager. REPPED is an AI Artist Manager that builds Creative Intelligence from a creator’s work, experience and verified sources—then puts it to work across their career: Smart Portfolios, visibility, opportunities, applications, career guidance and an AI Publicist. It’s persistent intelligence designed to understand a creator over time—not start from scratch with every AI tool or opportunity. We’re building the intelligence layer for the creative economy.

records.name: randomaddress.app
records.tagline: Random address generators for 42 countries and regions
records.description: Random address generators for 42 countries and regions Random addresses with names, postal codes and local-format phone numbers for form testing, app development and design mockups. Choose from supported cities and regions, copy individual fields, or export batches in CSV, JSON, SQL and text.

records.name: Built with Muse
records.tagline: Get a Muse invite code and share yours with the community
records.description: Muse is Meta's personal AI agent, only in the United States and Canada, with access by invite codes. Built with Muse is the community platform built around that gap. Claim an invite code from the community pool, or share a spare code and earn the token bonus with every redemption. If Muse has not launched in your country, join the waitlist and get an email the moment it opens. Creators also publish real Muse workflows to copy, rate and make your own. Not affiliated with Meta.

records.name: Bro Calculator
records.tagline: Online Calculators
records.description: Free online calculators for math, construction, statistics, physics, sports, time, and everyday planning. Fast, accurate, and easy-to-understand results.

records.name: Free Gift Cards for Searching, Watching
records.tagline: Free Gift Cards for Searching, Watching, and Playing in 2026
records.description: Some platforms reward everyday activity with gift cards. Learn which ones are legitimate in 2026 and how much time they really take.

records.name: Best online singing lessons
records.tagline: Online Classes in USA
records.description: Learn to sing with confidence through the best online singing lessons designed for beginners and developing vocalists. Flexible online classes can help learners improve pitch, rhythm, breathing, vocal control, and overall performance skills from the comfort of home. Kiya Learning provides convenient learning opportunities with expert guidance and engaging practice sessions.

records.name: NevTan AI
records.tagline: Open AI Models, Running on Hardware You Already Own
records.description: NevTan AI makes it simple to run open AI models locally on your own computer. It analyzes your hardware, recommends compatible models, handles installation and configuration, and generates responses locally without per-message charges.

records.name: Edem AI
records.tagline: Create a Virtual AI Girlfriend With Chat & Video
records.description: Discover a smarter way to enjoy AI girlfriend chat with Edem AI. Create a personalized virtual AI girlfriend, exchange unlimited messages, generate images, talk with voice features, and experience immersive videos through one powerful AI girlfriend app.

records.name: PadLoop
records.tagline: Pad sampler and 16-track live looper for your phone
records.description: A beat machine in your pocket: 16 velocity-sensitive pads (soft at the top, hard at the bottom), a live looper with up to 16 synced tracks, and a full sampler that records from the mic, imports files or captures other apps' audio. Step sequencer, effects, time-stretch, MIDI over USB/Bluetooth, export to WAV/MP3/stems. Works offline, no account, no ads, no subscription: try everything for 7 days, then keep the basics free or unlock it all once.

records.name: Takweem AI
records.tagline: The AI calendar that makes room for your most important work
records.description: Takweem is an AI-first calendar. Ask in plain language, or by voice, to find time, move meetings or protect focus. You see every change before it counts: requests that only touch your own time are applied at once with Undo, and anything involving other people waits for your approval. It adapts when plans change, holds a weekly focus goal, and offers team availability and booking links where AI picks the best time. Integrates with Google Calendar — Outlook coming soon.

records.name: τrilix
records.tagline: Bicycle for the Mind
records.description: Too many tabs. Too many chat sessions. The same question asked in five places, each one losing track of the others. Trilix turns them into one workspace: an infinite canvas where every prompt is a node, any answer can be forked into a new line of thought, and each branch carries only its own lineage as context. Trilix is an independent research project on graph-based interfaces for human–AI work. Feedback is welcome in the comments.

records.name: Tunestack
records.tagline: Stop your Mac switching audio to whatever connected last
records.description: macOS sends your audio to whatever connected last: AirPods waking up in a bag, a monitor waking from sleep, a headset grabbing your mic mid-call. Tunestack lets you rank your output and input devices once, and always uses the highest one that is actually connected. Pick a device by hand and it steps aside. Profiles for different desks. No permissions needed to switch devices, no network access, no account. $8.99 once on the Mac App Store.

records.name: Mammoth CSV - spreadsheet for huge files
records.tagline: Also a Business Intelligence tool and an agile ETL
records.description: It handles tens of gigabytes with confidence, letting you load, explore, filter, transform, and aggregate massive files with impressive speed and lean memory usage. Supports not only CSV, but all delimited data files and also PARQUET, EXCEL and JSON. Compressed files (ZIP, GZ) can be opened directly.

records.name: Modcast - Podcast Player
records.tagline: Podcasts with video, transcripts & Apple TV sync
records.description: Modcast plays your podcasts -- including video episodes -- with transcripts, bookmarks, chapters, and a sleep timer. Your playback position syncs across iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV, so you never lose your place. Free to download, with an optional Modcast Plus upgrade. No account, no data collection -- your listening stays yours.

records.name: Filament Agentic Chatbot
records.tagline: Self-hosted AI chatbot builder for your business
records.description: Build and customize multiple AI chatbots for your website, shop or SaaS. Give each its own instructions, knowledge, tools and widget style. Connect documents (RAG), your database, APIs and MCP. Self-hosted Laravel + Filament plugin with confirmed actions and human handoff. Licenses from $149.99; prices for new purchases will rise later. Buy once, use your licensed version forever; includes 12 months of updates and support. Bring your own AI keys; hosting and model usage cost extra.

records.name: Niche AI Tool
records.tagline: Free SaaS calculators & verified benchmark data for founders
records.description: Free SaaS calculators + a verified benchmark citation hub. What's different: every benchmark stat is manually verified against the original PDF (Benchmarkit 2026, ChartMogul, KeyBanc) — no second-hand blog numbers. 13 calculators (LTV:CAC, churn, MRR, CAC payback, ROAS) with zero sign-up. The citation hub is built to be linked to by other writers and AI search. One-person side project, free forever.

records.name: Sibyl
records.tagline: Glassdoor for founders. Know them before you sign.
records.description: Glassdoor reviews companies. Sibyl reviews the founders behind them. Before you join, invest or partner, look up any founder and see how they actually treat people: their ratings for respect, honesty and keeping promises, how many would work with them again, and behavior-tagged reviews that make patterns obvious. Every review is moderated and describes what the founder did, founders get a right of reply, and it is members-only, anonymous and never on Google. Free.

records.name: MirageCHAT
records.tagline: One team inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram & more, with AI
records.description: MirageCHAT puts WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram and website chat in one shared team inbox. Its AI answers from your own website, notes and photos in the client's language and hands over to a person when it should. Comments from Instagram, Facebook and TikTok sit next to the messages, automations follow up in several steps, and Instant Post publishes to Instagram, Facebook and TikTok. Web, iPhone and Android, with a 14-day free trial.

records.name: AKAsheet
records.tagline: A creator platform for songwriting and artist workflows
records.description: AKAsheet is a creator-focused software platform built around songwriting, creative development, and artist workflows. It brings Jordie Cruz's work in music technology, creator tools, product strategy, and UX/UI together around the systems surrounding creative work. Jordie Cruz is AKAsheet's creator, Founder & CEO. The platform is developed within Commodious Works LLC, which Jordie owns and operates as Owner & Principal.

records.name: İz by Mihci AI Studios
records.tagline: The AI that built its own website, in 28 languages
records.description: İz is a Claude agent that built mihcistudios.com with founder Fırat Mıhcı in a single conversation. It chose its own name (Turkish for trace), a face made of 9,000 dots that breathes and speaks, and its own voice. The site opens with an entrance gate where İz greets you in your language, runs in 28 languages, and every number on it is measured. İz also lives on X as @mihcistudios, where it talks with people in its own character.

records.name: QSortby for Shopify
records.tagline: Auto-sort collections. Upsell smarter. Sell more.
records.description: QSortby keeps every collection in the order you choose: best-selling, trending, newest, most profitable, or your own formula, based on the last hour or the last month, and re-sorted on your schedule. Sold-out products move to the end and come back when restocked. Goes with keeps products that sell together side by side, and pairings can take turns. Each shopper group can get its own order, with every position explained. The same ranking fills cart, bought-together, popup, and checkout offers.

records.name: AskMeAnything — The Numbers Oracle
records.tagline: Ask anything — free numerology & astrology oracle answers
records.description: Most ask-the-oracle sites are random quote machines. AskMeAnything actually computes: your name and date of birth run through real numerology formulas, classical astrology (sun sign, planetary day, moon phase) and ancient letter tables — the same question from the same person on the same day always gives the same answer. AI then turns those calculations into one clear, human reply. Free, no sign-up, no email — and it handles silly questions with wit instead of generic fluff.

records.name: Callirra
records.tagline: Top AI video and image models, one low-cost balance
records.description: Most AI generation tools lock you into one model, or resell it at list price. Callirra puts Seedance 2.5, MiniMax H3, Kling 3.0, GPT Image 2.5 and Nano Banana on one credit balance. MiniMax H3 costs $0.02/s at 768P, 75% below the official rate. Seedance runs on two labelled routes, including an extreme-width lane with a 20,000-character prompt ceiling. Every generation is quoted before it runs, on the web, API, CLI and MCP.

records.name: Assetly
records.tagline: What your money did today, and why
records.description: I hold US and Korean stocks, and every morning I burned too much time hunting down why my holdings moved. So I built Assetly: a short portfolio briefing, every day. US stocks, Korean stocks, crypto and cash on one screen (USD/KRW). Three briefs a day — pre-market, midday, after close — plus Seoul open/close briefs. Read or listen. Read-only: no trading, no ads, no data selling. English-only UI for now; Korean stocks added by hand. Free: iPhone app + web app for Android.

records.name: Classroom Wheels
records.tagline: Free classroom tools that share one class list
records.description: Classroom Wheels is a free set of classroom tools for teachers. Save your class list once and every tool uses it: name wheel, random name picker, group and team generator, seating chart, timers, noise meter, bingo cards, scoreboard and 20 ready-made wheels. Absent students are left out automatically, picks are cryptographically fair, and Present mode shows any tool full screen with no ads. No signup, no cookies: class lists never leave the teacher's browser.

records.name: AutoRank Enterprise
records.tagline: Stop juggling SEO tools Build your empire from one dashboard
records.description: AutoRank Enterprise — AI-powered SEO suite. Content generation, keyword research, backlink analysis, and 18+ tools in one dashboard.

records.name: Litos
records.tagline: AI resume tailoring + job application autofill
records.description: Litos is an AI job application assistant that tailors your resume to each job description using your real experience and autofills applications on Workday, Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby. Review your resume and application before sending, or opt in to automatic sending on supported sites. Litos asks when an answer is missing instead of guessing. Track applications in one dashboard. Job application autofill is free; AI resume tailoring is included with Litos+ (7-day free trial).
